keywords: digital cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia

detail.abstract:
Objectives: Insomnia is a highly prevalent disorder; however, access to its first-line treatment, cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia (CBT-I) remains highly limited. We aimed to evaluate the clinical and cost-effectiveness of an intelligent digital CBT-I.

Methods: We conducted a prospective, multicenter, open-label, pragmatic randomized controlled trial comparing the clinical and cost-effectiveness of intelligent digital CBT-I-based diagnosis and therapy for insomnia (IDT) with sleep hygiene education (SH). Adult participants with insomnia disorder were recruited from 4 hospitals in China. Eligible participants were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive either IDT or SH. Outcomes were assessed at 6 week and 3 months. The primary endpoint was self-reported insomnia severity at 6 weeks, measured using the Insomnia Severity Index (ISI). The primary analysis followed the intention-to-treat principle and included all randomized participants. Cost-effectiveness was evaluated from a societal perspective and expressed as incremental cost-effectiveness ratios and incremental net monetary benefit. The trial was prospectively registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT07357779).

Results: Between January 20, 2026, and May 10, 2026, 404 participants were randomly assigned to IDT (n = 202) or SH (n = 202). Of these, 246 participants (60.9%) were female and 158 (39.1%) were male; 228 (56.4%) were younger than 45 years, 127 (31.4%) were aged 45-59 years, and 49 (12.1%) were older than 59 years. At 6 weeks, the mean ISI score was 8.41 (SD, 5.63) in the IDT group and 12.97 (SD, 4.95) in the SH group (adjusted mean difference, -4.56; 95% CI, -5.43 to -3.69; P < 0.001; Cohen d, -0.86). From a societal perspective, IDT was associated with lower costs (incremental cost, -¥385.97; 95% CI, -¥545.39 to -¥240.56) and greater clinical remission (incremental remission, 24.6%; 95% CI, 14.3% to 34.4%), yielding an ICER of -¥1568.98 per additional remitter. The incremental net monetary benefit was ¥1004.19 at a willingness-to-pay threshold of ¥90,000 per quality-adjusted life year gained. No serious adverse events were reported in either group.

Conclusions: The Intelligent digital CBT-I-based diagnosis and therapy effectively alleviates insomnia symptoms and demonstrates superior cost-effectiveness. These findings suggest its potential for implementation as a first-line treatment for insomnia disorder.

AI.tldr: 一项在中国四家医院开展的多中心、开放标签、前瞻性随机对照试验表明，智能数字认知行为疗法（IDT）在治疗失眠障碍方面，相比睡眠卫生教育（SH）在6周时显著改善失眠严重程度（ISI评分差-4.56，Cohen d=-0.86），且从社会角度具有更低的成本和更高的临床缓解率，具备成为一线治疗的潜力。
AI.research_question: 智能数字认知行为疗法（IDT）在治疗失眠障碍中的临床疗效和成本效益如何？
AI.motivation: 失眠症患病率高，但其一线治疗——失眠认知行为疗法（CBT-I）的可及性极为有限，需要探索数字化解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 失眠认知行为疗法（CBT-I）理论框架
AI.method: 前瞻性、多中心、开放标签、实用性随机对照试验，将智能数字CBT-I（IDT）与睡眠卫生教育（SH）进行对比，纳入中国4家医院404名失眠障碍成人患者，主要结局指标为6周时失眠严重程度指数（ISI），采用意向性治疗分析，并从社会角度评估成本效益。
AI.findings: IDT组6周时ISI平均得分（8.41±5.63）显著低于SH组（12.97±4.95），调整后均差为-4.56（95% CI: -5.43至-3.69, P<0.001），效应量Cohen d为-0.86。IDT成本更低（增量成本-¥385.97）且临床缓解率更高（增量缓解率24.6%），ICER为-¥1568.98/每额外缓解者。两组均无严重不良事件报告。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了数字化CBT-I在真实世界环境中的临床有效性和成本效益，为CBT-I的数字化传播提供了循证依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 智能数字CBT-I有望作为失眠障碍的一线治疗方案推广实施，显著提高循证心理治疗的可及性，降低医疗成本。

title: The AMA Method -Analytical Foundations of Its Failure

detail.title: The AMA Method -Analytical Foundations of Its Failure
detail.abstract:
In 2024, the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, implementing the CRR III regulation, withdrew the Advanced Measurement Approach for operational risk (AMA) — a model built on an actuarial foundation — ending its twenty-year history in the banking sector. The official justification was excessive dispersion of model results across institutions, undermining comparability of capital requirements. This article argues that such dispersion was merely a symptom — the deeper problem being a structural inconsistency of the framework, embedded in its assumptions from the outset.

Three structural properties of the AMA framework are derived. Property (1) concerns the domination of distant quantiles of the aggregate loss distribution by a single extreme loss when heavy-tailed severity distributions are applied. Property (2) demonstrates that the AMA model outcome is determined by quantiles of the severity distribution higher by one or more orders of magnitude than the regulatory quantile of 0.999. Property (3) indicates the dependence of the extreme loss value — which determines the model outcome — on the count of minor, negligible operational events. The occurrence of these properties was verified by a numerical Monte Carlo experiment.

The results indicate that the combined effect of the derived properties led to the necessity of estimation at quantiles of the order 0.9999, 0.99999 and higher — levels beyond the capabilities of reliable statistical modeling given data volumes available in banking practice. Also critical was the ambiguity in the definition of rarity, and the transfer of that concept onto the single loss distribution axis — a transfer arising from the joint occurrence of properties (1), (2), and (3). Rarity readings on this axis depended on the quantile positioning of extreme losses, which could itself depend on the count of low-value, negligible losses. The observed dispersion of results across institutions may therefore have been a consequence of these unintended structural inadequacies, rather than the result of modeling errors.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了巴塞尔委员会在2024年取消的AMA操作风险高级计量法的深层问题：其分散性并非建模错误，而是框架本身固有的三个结构性缺陷所致，包括极端损失主导尾部、实际估计分位数远高于监管要求，以及模型结果依赖于微不足道的低值事件数量，导致需要在0.9999甚至更高分位数进行不可靠的统计推断。
AI.research_question: AMA框架中模型结果在机构间过度分散的根本原因是什么？是建模错误还是框架本身的结构性缺陷？
AI.motivation: 巴塞尔委员会以模型结果分散性为由取消了AMA方法，但作者认为分散性只是表象，需深入探究AM A框架是否存在内在的结构性矛盾，以为监管决策提供更深刻的理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 精算损失分布法（Actuarial Loss Distribution Approach）；重尾分布理论；极值理论（Extreme Value Theory）；分位数估计理论
AI.method: 理论推导：从AMA框架的数学结构中导出三个结构性属性；数值实验：通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证这些属性的实际发生情况。
AI.findings: （1）重尾分布下聚合损失分布的远距离分位数被单个极端损失主导；（2）AMA模型结果实际由比监管0.999分位数高一个或多个数量级的严重程度分位数决定；（3）决定模型结果的极端损失值依赖于微小、可忽略的操作事件数量。三者共同导致需要在0.9999、0.99999甚至更高分位数进行估计，超出了银行实务中数据量的可靠建模能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地识别并数学推导出AMA框架的三个结构性属性，揭示了模型结果分散性的根源在于框架本身而非建模误差，为操作风险监管方法的理论批判提供了严谨的分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴塞尔委员会取消AMA提供了更深层次的理论支撑；警示未来监管框架设计需避免类似的结构性不一致问题；指出依赖极端高分位数进行资本计量的内在不可靠性。

title: On the Limits of Low-Frequency OHLCV Signals in Machine Learning-Driven Portfolio Optimization A Cost-Aware, Leak-Free Benchmark on Large-Cap US Equities

detail.title: On the Limits of Low-Frequency OHLCV Signals in Machine Learning-Driven Portfolio Optimization A Cost-Aware, Leak-Free Benchmark on Large-Cap US Equities
detail.abstract: The application of machine learning (ML) to quantitative finance has grown rapidly, yet financial return series have an extremely low signal-to-noise ratio and are non-stationary, exposing predictive pipelines to severe backtest overfitting. We conduct a rigorous, leak-free, cost-aware stress-test of whether ML models trained only on monthly features derived from daily OHLCV price and volume data can produce economically meaningful, net-of-cost portfolio improvements over disciplined baselines, on a universe of 30 large-cap US equities (2010-2025). A wide spectrum of models, namely regularized linear regressors, tree ensembles, and deep networks (MLP, 1D-CNN, LSTM, CNN-LSTM, Transformer), is evaluated under an anchored walk-forward scheme that retrains at each step, with a pre-specified promotion gate (mean out-of-sample Spearman Rank IC ≥ 0.05 on a 2016 hold-out) that admits only the MLP among the deep models. Promoted forecasts enter a Black-Litterman optimizer as Bayesian views, with Marchenko-Pastur covariance cleaning, dollar-neutral constraints, and realistic transaction costs (10 bps). We report a negative result: in the out-of-sample period (2017-2025) the best model (MLP, Sharpe 0.96) only marginally edges a no-ML Black-Litterman "Prior-Only" baseline (Sharpe 0.94) that shares the same covariance cleaning, while incurring more than three times the cumulative transaction cost (15.13% vs. 4.67%). More strikingly, a naive equally weighted 1/30 portfolio attains a Sharpe of 0.93, essentially tying the entire optimized apparatus. Fama-French five-factor alphas of the active linear and tree strategies are statistically insignificant. The risk-adjusted performance of the pipeline is driven by covariance regularization and Bayesian shrinkage, expressed mainly as superior drawdown control, rather than by the predictive content of the models. We release a fully reproducible pipeline as a baseline for future studies.

AI.tldr: 本文系统测试了机器学习模型在量化金融中的实际效用，发现模型预测带来的边际收益极小，组合表现主要来自协方差正则化和贝叶斯收缩，而非预测能力。
AI.research_question: 基于日频OHLCV数据的机器学习模型是否能在扣除交易成本后，为大规模美股投资组合带来经济上有意义的超额收益？
AI.motivation: 金融收益率序列信噪比极低且非平稳，ML模型极易过拟合。现有文献缺乏严格的、无信息泄漏的、考虑交易成本的实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: Black-Litterman贝叶斯观点融合、Marchenko-Pastur协方差清理、Fama-French五因子模型、Spearman Rank IC评估、锚定滚动窗口回测框架。
AI.method: 在30只大盘美股（2010-2025）上，对线性回归、树集成、深度网络（MLP、1D-CNN、LSTM、CNN-LSTM、Transformer）进行锚定滚动窗口训练，设置晋升门槛（IC≥0.05）；通过Black-Litterman优化器生成组合，考虑10bps交易成本，与无ML基准对比。
AI.findings: 仅MLP通过晋升门槛；MLP的夏普比率（0.96）略高于无ML基准（0.94），但交易成本是后者的三倍多；等权1/30组合夏普0.93几乎持平；线性与树策略的Fama-French五因子alpha不显著；风险调整收益主要由协方差正则化驱动。
AI.theory_contributions: 严谨证明了在严苛条件下，基于OHLCV数据的ML预测对组合优化的边际贡献极其有限，揭示了"预测能力幻觉"与协方差正则化的混淆效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了完全可复现的代码基线，警示从业者ML策略的真实价值可能来自风险建模而非预测，应审慎评估交易成本对净收益的侵蚀。

title: Two Roads Diverge and Converge in the AI Era: Computer-Generated Works as an Exception for Human Authorship?
affiliations: School of Law, City University of Hong Kong

detail.title: Two Roads Diverge and Converge in the AI Era: Computer-Generated Works as an Exception for Human Authorship?
detail.abstract:
The intersection of copyright law and artificial intelligence (AI) presents numerous unresolved challenges, while the copyrightability of AI-generated content (AIGC) is particularly complex. Jurisdictions have adopted distinct approaches that converge and diverge in addressing this matter. Classic human authorship jurisdictions, such as the United States (US), China, and the European Union (EU), require AIGC to satisfy human authorship and originality requirements to be copyrightable. As a result, their debates focus on the level of original authorial contributions required for AIGC protection. In contrast, jurisdictions following the computer-generated works (CGWs) doctrine, such as the United Kingdom (UK) and Hong Kong (HK), diverge significantly when applying a plain interpretation approach. These jurisdictions treat AIGC as copyrightable subject matter regardless of originality standard, even though they also generally follow the human authorship requirement. The convergences and divergences among these jurisdictions make their comparison particularly valuable to explore. 


To unpack this convergence and divergence, the article first examines relevant scholarly debates and recent legal developments in classic human authorship jurisdictions (represented by the US, China, and the EU) that illustrate how they address the copyrightability of AIGC. It then explores the CGWs doctrine in jurisdictions such as the UK and HK, highlighting how their approaches may differ significantly. In light of these divergences, particularly under a plain interpretation approach, the article argues that the divergent stance adopted by CGWs jurisdictions is doctrinally problematic and lacks theoretical justification. The article proposes a refined doctrinal approach to the CGWs doctrine that aligns more closely with the frameworks in human authorship jurisdictions regarding AIGC protection. While some divergences may persist, this refined approach establishes a more reasonable and justifiable framework, fostering greater convergence between the two systems.


This comparative analysis offers insights on unified pathways forward for jurisdictions navigating AI and copyright. These pathways include developing a more reasonable originality standard for AIGC, exploring limitations on AIGC copyright protection, and acknowledging the diminishing role of copyright law in the AI era. This recognition of the diminishing role underscores the need for alternative solutions beyond the traditional copyright regime to address emerging challenges more directly and efficiently.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了经典人类作者身份法域（美国、中国、欧盟）与计算机生成作品法域（英国、香港）在AI生成内容可版权性上的异同，指出CGW法域在文义解释下缺乏理论正当性，并提出改进路径以促进两大体系趋同。
AI.research_question: 不同法域在AI生成内容可版权性上的趋同与分歧是什么？如何调和CGW法域与人类作者法域之间的理论矛盾？
AI.motivation: AI生成内容的版权问题日益突出，但各国处理方式存在显著分歧，尤其是CGW法域与经典人类作者法域之间的差异缺乏理论解释与调和。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人类作者身份理论（人类创作与原创性要求）、计算机生成作品理论（文义解释路径）、比较法分析框架。
AI.method: 比较法研究，对美国、中国、欧盟、英国、香港等法域的立法、司法实践和学术争论进行系统对比分析。
AI.findings: 经典人类作者法域要求AIGC满足人类作者身份和原创性标准，争论焦点在于保护所需的创作贡献水平；CGW法域将AIGC视为可版权客体而不考虑原创性标准，这一立场在理论上缺乏正当性。本文提出改进的CGW理论路径，使其与人类作者法域框架更加协调。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了CGW法域文义解释路径的理论缺陷，提出了修正后的CGW理论框架，推动了AI版权领域比较法理论的发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国制定AIGC版权政策提供了统一的前进路径：建立合理的原创性标准、探索版权保护限制、承认版权法在AI时代作用日渐式微并寻求替代方案。

detail.abstract:
Background: The NHS Health Check is a major cardiovascular disease prevention programme, but long-term evidence on its clinical impact and cost-effectiveness is limited. This study assessed associations between attendance, health outcomes, healthcare costs, and cost-effectiveness over ten years.

Methods: A retrospective population-based cohort study was conducted using linked healthcare and cost data covering 2·7 million people, encompassing years 2015 to 2025. Adults aged 40–74 years eligible for an NHS Health Check were included. Primary outcomes were all-cause mortality and first major adverse cardiovascular event (MACE). Secondary outcomes were cardiometabolic risk factor detection and guideline-directed medical therapy initiation and sustainment. Health economic outcomes included quality-adjusted life years (QALYs) and incremental cost-effectiveness ratio (ICER). Hazard ratios were estimated using time-varying Cox models; all analyses were adjusted using inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW).

Findings: Among 925,072 eligible adults, 445,446 (48·1%) attended an NHS Health Check. Non-attendees had a higher risk of all-cause mortality (HR 1·31, 95%CI 1·26–1·35) and first MACE (1·09, 1·05–1·14). Over ten years, this corresponded to one fewer premature death per 116 attendees and one fewer first MACE per 751 attendees. Attendance was associated with gains of 0·11 QALYs for mortality (ICER £9,006 per QALY) and 0·03 QALYs for MACE (ICER £36,923 per QALY).

Interpretation: NHS Health Check attendance was associated with lower mortality, MACE, and favourable economic profile. Reducing inequalities in uptake and improving engagement of non-attendees is necessary to maximise population benefit.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于270万人、为期十年的数据，评估了NHS健康检查项目的临床效果和成本效益。结果显示，参加健康检查的人群全因死亡率降低31%（每116名参与者减少1例过早死亡），主要不良心血管事件风险降低9%（每751名参与者减少1例）。健康检查还与更高的生活质量调整寿命年（QALY）和良好的成本效益比相关，每QALY成本为9,006英镑（死亡率）和36,923英镑（MACE）。
AI.research_question: NHS健康检查（英国一项主要的心血管疾病预防项目）在十年随访期内，其临床影响和成本效益如何？
AI.motivation: NHS健康检查是英国一项大规模心血管疾病预防计划，但关于其长期临床效果和成本效益的证据尚不充分。已有研究多为短期或横断面设计，缺乏基于真实世界大样本、长期随访的数据支持，因此需要系统性评估该项目的实际价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究基于心血管疾病预防的公共卫生理论框架，结合健康经济学中的成本效用分析理论（QALY和ICER），以及因果推断中的逆概率治疗加权（IPTW）方法控制选择偏倚。
AI.method: 采用回顾性人群队列研究设计，使用2015-2025年间的关联医疗健康数据（覆盖270万人）。纳入40-74岁符合NHS健康检查资格的成年人。主要结局为全因死亡率和首次主要不良心血管事件（MACE）。采用时变Cox模型估计风险比，所有分析均使用逆概率治疗加权（IPTW）进行调整。
AI.findings: 在925,072名符合条件的成人中，445,446人（48.1%）参加了NHS健康检查。未参加者全因死亡率风险更高（HR 1.31, 95%CI 1.26-1.35），首次MACE风险更高（HR 1.09, 95%CI 1.05-1.14）。十年间，每116名参与者减少1例过早死亡，每751名参与者减少1例首次MACE。参加健康检查与0.11 QALY（死亡率模型，ICER £9,006/QALY）和0.03 QALY（MACE模型，ICER £36,923/QALY）的增益相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 为大规模心血管疾病预防项目的长期效果提供了基于真实世界数据的因果推断证据，验证了健康检查作为公共卫生干预措施的理论有效性。同时，展示了IPTW和时变Cox模型在大规模观察性研究中控制混杂因素的应用价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为英国NHS健康检查项目的持续实施提供了有力的临床和经济学证据支持。结果表明该项目具有良好的成本效益（£9,006/QALY和£36,923/QALY均低于英国NHS通常采用的£20,000-£30,000/QALY支付意愿阈值），建议通过减少参与不平等性和提高未参与者的参与度来最大化人群健康收益。

title: An Empirical Test of Rank-Dependent Probability Weighting
affiliations: and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: An Empirical Test of Rank-Dependent Probability Weighting
detail.abstract: Cumulative Prospect Theory (Tversky and Kahneman, 1992) modified Original Prospect Theory (Kahneman and Tversky, 1979) so that decision weights depend on the rank of the outcome. Rank dependence rules out violations of first-order stochastic dominance and extends prospect theory to probability distributions with any number of outcomes. This representation also has sharp, testable empirical implications: given well-documented properties of the probability weighting function, decision weights should be larger for the highest-ranked outcome than for intermediate outcomes. We test whether decision weights are indeed rank-dependent using a large sample of binary choices (1,989 participants and 59,517 choices). The 125 gamble pairs were designed to allow semi-parametric estimation of decision weights. Our estimates show strong evidence for rank dependence: decision weights for the highest-valued outcome are significantly larger than those for the middle outcome. Although both models are statistically rejected, our estimated decision weights are considerably closer to Cumulative Prospect Theory than Original Prospect Theory. Moreover, in an out-of-sample prediction exercise, Cumulative Prospect Theory predicts three-outcome choice percentages substantially better than Original Prospect Theory. Our results thus provide a strong empirical basis for the use of Cumulative Prospect Theory in economic applications.

AI.tldr: 本文利用大样本实验（1,989名参与者，59,517次选择）检验了累积前景理论（CPT）的核心假设——决策权重依赖于结果排序。实证结果强有力地支持了CPT：最高排序结果的决策权重大大高于中间结果，且CPT在样本外预测中显著优于原始前景理论。
AI.research_question: 决策权重是否确实具有排序依赖性（rank dependence）？累积前景理论是否比原始前景理论更能解释和预测人们的风险决策行为？
AI.motivation: 累积前景理论修改了原始前景理论，引入排序依赖性以排除一阶随机占优的违背，并扩展至任意数量的结果。该理论有可检验的实证含义，但缺乏大样本、严格的实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 累积前景理论（Cumulative Prospect Theory, CPT）；原始前景理论（Original Prospect Theory, OPT）；排序依赖性（rank dependence）；概率权重函数（probability weighting function）。
AI.method: 大样本实验室实验：1,989名参与者，59,517次选择，125对赌局（含二结果与三结果）。采用半参数方法估计决策权重，并进行样本内拟合与样本外预测比较。
AI.findings: （1）决策权重具有显著的排序依赖性：最高结果的决策权重大大高于中间结果；（2）两种模型在统计上均被拒绝，但CPT的拟合优度远优于OPT；（3）在样本外预测中，CPT预测三结果赌局选择百分比的效果显著优于OPT。
AI.theory_contributions: 为大样本下CPT的排序依赖性假设提供了强有力的实证证据；表明CPT比OPT更接近人类实际决策模式，为CPT在经济学中的应用提供了坚实的经验基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济模型中采用累积前景理论（而非原始前景理论）提供了实证依据；对政策设计、金融决策和行为经济学应用具有指导意义。

title: Direct from Syndication: Syndication Costs, Liquidity, and Growth of Direct Lending
affiliations: University of Florida - Department of Finance, Insurance and Real Estate, University of Florida - Warrington College of Business Administration and University of Florida - Department of Finance, Insurance and Real Estate

detail.title: Direct from Syndication: Syndication Costs, Liquidity, and Growth of Direct Lending
detail.abstract: Middle-market corporate borrowing has shifted away from syndicated loans toward bilateral lending funded by private credit funds. One reason for this shift is the demand uncertainty associated with syndicated lending. We argue that demand uncertainty requires underwriters to have access to liquidity and that the amount of liquidity needed depends on the severity of syndication frictions. We measure syndication frictions using the time in syndication and the flex terms used in the syndication process. Using a large sample of syndicated loan and direct-lending transactions we find that syndication frictions predict borrowers switching to direct lending. For arrangers, we argue that liquidity requirements imposed in 2016 increased the costs of underwriting syndicated loans. Consistent with the liquidity-cost channel, we find a significant increase in the sensitivity of underwriting fees and switching propensities to syndication frictions after the introduction of liquidity requirements. In addition, we find banks that were more exposed to liquidity requirements due to the lack of a large stable deposit base, reduced their liquidity intensive lending activity more than banks with more stable funding sources.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了企业借款从银团贷款转向由私募信贷基金资助的双边贷款的现象，认为需求不确定性和流动性要求是驱动这一转变的关键因素。
AI.research_question: 为什么中等市场企业借款从银团贷款转向由私募信贷基金提供的双边直接贷款？
AI.motivation: 银团贷款中存在需求不确定性，这要求承销商具备流动性，而流动性需求的大小取决于银团摩擦的严重程度。2016年实施的流动性要求增加了承销成本，进一步推动了这一转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 需求不确定性理论、流动性成本理论、银团摩擦理论
AI.method: 使用银团贷款和直接贷款交易的大样本数据，以银团时间和灵活条款衡量银团摩擦，分析借款人转向直接贷款的行为，并考察2016年流动性要求实施前后承销费用和转换倾向对银团摩擦敏感度的变化。
AI.findings: 银团摩擦可以预测借款人转向直接贷款；流动性要求实施后，承销费用和转换倾向对银团摩擦的敏感度显著增加；缺乏稳定存款基础的银行减少了流动性密集型贷款活动。
AI.theory_contributions: 将需求不确定性和流动性成本引入银团贷款与直接贷款的选择分析框架，揭示了监管流动性要求对贷款市场结构的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为借款人和贷款机构理解银团贷款与直接贷款之间的转换动因提供了实证依据，对银行流动性管理和监管政策制定具有参考价值。

title: Renewable generator bidding: The role of market conditions and power purchase agreements
affiliations: Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT University) - School of Economics, Finance and Marketing, Monash University, Griffith University and Griffith University

detail.title: Renewable generator bidding: The role of market conditions and power purchase agreements
detail.abstract: Our paper examines how wholesale market clearing prices and the presence or absence of long-run power purchase agreements (PPAs) impacts on renewable generator bidding strategies and patterns in Australia’s National Electricity Market (NEM). We establish and analyse typical bidding strategies of renewable generators in South-Australia, the state with the highest penetration of renewable generation in Australia. We use model-based clustering to identify 22 typical behavioural profiles, which we call strategies, based on the bids of 26 generators on a 5-minute basis during 2023. We analyse these 22 strategies as a function of wholesale market clearing prices, as well as our assessment of the presence or absence of power purchase agreements. We find that most of the time - in line with economic expectations - renewable generators bid predominantly negative or close to zero AUD/MWh, the extent of the negative bids depending on their contractual (revenue) structures and market clearing prices. However, periods of sustained or deep negative market clearing prices are associated with a profile containing 100 % of bids close to or at the price ceiling. We recognise this as potential economic curtailment aimed at avoiding dispatch in the absence of no-floor power purchase agreements. These findings have significant consequences for market and system design. Our results show that the structures of contracts designed to reflect long-term public policy support for new investment are likely to influence spot-market pricing outcome. As such, long-term investment policies should consider design frameworks that are integrated with medium-term risk management and short-term operational market timeframes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究澳大利亚国家电力市场中，批发市场出清价格和长期购电协议对可再生能源发电机投标策略的影响，发现大多数时候发电机以负价或零价投标，但在持续深度负价期间会出现以价格上限投标的经济弃电行为。
AI.research_question: 批发市场出清价格和长期购电协议（PPA）如何影响澳大利亚国家电力市场（NEM）中可再生能源发电机的投标策略和模式？
AI.motivation: 随着可再生能源渗透率提高，理解其投标行为对市场设计和系统稳定性至关重要，但现有研究对PPA与投标策略关系的实证分析不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场经济学理论，利用模型聚类方法识别投标策略模式，并结合合同结构（PPA有无）分析行为差异。
AI.method: 对南澳大利亚州26个可再生能源发电机2023年每5分钟一次的投标数据，采用基于模型的聚类分析，识别22种典型投标策略，然后按出清价格和PPA存在与否进行交叉分析。
AI.findings: （1）大多数情况下，可再生能源发电机以接近零或负的AUD/MWh投标，负价程度取决于合同结构和出清价格；（2）在持续或深度负出清价格期间，出现100%投标接近或等于价格上限的策略，这被认为是在缺乏无底价PPA情况下的经济弃电行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了长期购电协议结构对短期现货市场价格结果的影响机制，拓展了可再生能源投标行为与合同设计之间关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和市场设计者提供建议：长期投资政策应设计与中期风险管理和短期运营市场时间框架相整合的框架，以应对可再生能源高渗透率下的市场挑战。

title: The Emission Trading System and Industrial Resilience: Performance and Policy Implications
affiliations: University of Milano - Bicocca - Department of Business and Law, University of Milano - Bicocca - Department of Business and Law, Università degli Studi di Milano-Bicocca - Department of Business Administration, Finance, Management and Law and University of Milan-Bicocca

detail.title: The Emission Trading System and Industrial Resilience: Performance and Policy Implications
detail.abstract: The EU Emissions Trading System operates across hard-to-abate manufacturing sectors characterised by heterogeneous technological, infrastructural and energy-system conditions. We investigate the relationship between verified emissions, free allocation of allowances, benchmark structures and industrial decarbonisation feasibility across sectors and European countries. The empirical analysis combines an assessment of verified emissions and free allocation dynamics, a benchmarking exercise based on a nonparametric quartile-based performance indicator computed at the installation level, and an econometric analysis on sectoral emissions and carbon intensity. The evidence highlights substantial heterogeneity across sectors and installations: observed ETS exposure depends both on firm-level efficiency and on broader structural conditions, including electricity systems, infrastructure availability, energy costs and access to low-carbon energy vectors. Benchmark-based allocation mechanisms may partially incorporate structural territorial advantages into observable ETS performance outcomes. Industrial decarbonisation is less mediated by the carbon price signal alone than by the interactions among technological readiness, infrastructure deployment and the energy production mix. Where commercially scalable transition pathways remain incomplete, progressively tighter carbon constraints risk materialising faster than firms' practical capacity to adjust production systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）在难以减排的制造业中的运行机制，发现排放强度、免费配额分配与基准结构之间存在显著异质性，工业脱碳更多取决于技术准备度、基础设施部署和能源结构等结构性条件，而非单纯依赖碳价格信号。
AI.research_question: EU ETS中，企业层面的验证排放、免费配额分配、基准结构与工业脱碳可行性之间存在怎样的关系？这种关系如何受到部门和跨国异质性的影响？
AI.motivation: EU ETS覆盖的制造业部门在技术、基础设施和能源系统条件上高度异质，但现有研究对这一异质性如何影响ETS运行效果和脱碳可行性的系统性理解不足，尤其缺乏结合排放动态、基准机制和经济计量分析的综合研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于碳排放交易理论、企业异质性理论、技术转型理论，以及基准分配机制的设计经济学。
AI.method: 结合三种实证方法：（1）验证排放与免费配额动态的评估；（2）基于非参数四分位数绩效指标在设施层面进行的基准分析；（3）对部门排放和碳强度的经济计量分析。
AI.findings: （1）部门和设施层面存在显著的异质性；（2）ETS暴露度既取决于企业层面的效率，也取决于电力系统、基础设施可用性、能源成本等更广泛的结构条件；（3）基于基准的配额分配机制可能将结构性地域优势部分转化为可观测的ETS绩效；（4）工业脱碳更多由技术准备度、基础设施部署与能源生产结构的互动所中介，而非仅靠碳价格信号；（5）在商业上可规模化的转型路径尚不完整时，逐渐收紧的碳约束可能比企业调整生产系统的实际能力更快地到来。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了碳定价之外的结构性条件（技术、基础设施、能源结构）对工业脱碳的关键中介作用，对传统的"碳价格驱动脱碳"理论构成修正和补充。
AI.practical_contributions: 为EU ETS政策设计提供重要启示：基准分配机制需要更精细化地考虑结构性差异；政策制定者应关注碳约束收紧速度与企业实际转型能力之间的匹配问题。

title: Radiofrequency Ablation Versus Standard Surgery for the Treatment of Second and Third Degree Haemorrhoids (ORION Trial): A Multicentre Double Blind Randomised Controlled Trial
affiliations: Sheffield Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust, University of Sheffield, University of Sheffield, University of Leeds, University of Sheffield, University of Sheffield, University of Sheffield - Health Economics and Decision Science Research Group (HEDS), affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Liverpool - Institute of Systems, Molecular and Integrative Biology, Dartford and Gravesham NHS Trust, University of Sheffield, University of Sheffield, University of Sheffield, University of Sheffield and University of Birmingham

detail.title: Radiofrequency Ablation Versus Standard Surgery for the Treatment of Second and Third Degree Haemorrhoids (ORION Trial): A Multicentre Double Blind Randomised Controlled Trial

declarations.declarationOfInterest: All authors have nothing to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Coordinated by Sheffield Clinical Trials Research Unit, and approved by the London–Queen Square Research Ethics Committee (21/LO/0762). Eligible participants provided written consent.
declarations.funderStatement: The ORION trial was funded by the UK National Institute of Health Research Technology Assessment Programme (NIHR131861).
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: The trial was registered on Dec 12, 2021 (ISRCTN14474552).

detail.abstract:
Background: Radiofrequency ablation (RFA) is a new treatment for haemorrhoidal disease. Proponents suggest it reduces postoperative pain and maintains low recurrence rates, however evidence for clinical effectiveness and cost remains limited.

Methods: ORION is a pragmatic, multicentre, patient- and assessor-blinded, parallel-group, randomised non-inferiority trial conducted in 17 acute UK National Health Service hospitals ( ISRCTN14474552).  Adults with symptomatic second- or third-degree haemorrhoids who had failed conservative management were randomised to RFA or standard care (SC).  SC comprised procedures recommended by European guidelines (haemorrhoidal artery ligation, haemorrhoidectomy, stapled haemorrhoidopexy), selected according to surgeon preference. Following patient consultation, postoperative pain (superiority) and recurrence (non-inferiority margin<10%) were selected as co-primary outcomes. The primary analyses were modified intention to treat.

Findings: Between 7th January 2022 and 8th January 2024, 383 participants (mean age 48·6 years, 61% male) were randomised. 179 patients underwent RFA, 152 received SC (131 haemorrhoidal artery ligation, 20 haemorrhoidectomy, one stapled haemorrhoidopexy), and 52 received no procedure. At postoperative day 7, the adjusted mean difference in self-reported pain between RFA and SC was 0·17 (95% CI -0·67, 1·01). Twelve-month recurrence was 47% after RFA versus 39% after SC (adjusted absolute difference 7·4%,95% CI -5·3% to 20·1%). Neither superiority for pain nor non-inferiority for recurrence was demonstrated.  Secondary outcomes (adverse events, symptom severity, incontinence, complications) were comparable. RFA reduced healthcare costs because of shorter operating times (adjusted mean difference 9·1 minutes, 95% CI 7·6, 10·7) and lower consumable costs but patients reported more time off work (mean difference 2·61 days, 95% CI 0·33-4·89).  

Interpretation: These findings do not support the routine adoption of RFA on the basis of improved patient-centred outcomes and highlight the importance of evaluating new surgical technologies before widespread implementation.

AI.tldr: 一项多中心随机非劣效性试验表明，射频消融术（RFA）治疗痔疮在术后疼痛（非优效）和12个月复发率（非劣效，RFA 47% vs 标准治疗39%）方面均未显示出优势，尽管RFA手术时间更短、耗材成本更低，但患者误工天数更多，研究不支持常规采用RFA。
AI.research_question: 与标准治疗（痔动脉结扎术、痔切除术、吻合器痔上黏膜环切术）相比，射频消融术（RFA）治疗有症状的Ⅱ-Ⅲ度痔疮在术后疼痛（优效性）和12个月复发率（非劣效性）方面是否更具优势？
AI.motivation: RFA作为一种治疗痔疮的新技术，支持者认为其能减少术后疼痛并维持低复发率，但临床有效性和成本方面的证据仍然有限，亟需高质量临床试验验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以患者为中心的结果评估框架，采用优效性检验（疼痛）和非劣效性检验（复发率，非劣效界值<10%）的双重终点设计。
AI.method: 实用主义、多中心、患者和评估者双盲、平行组、随机非劣效性试验，在英国17家NHS医院进行。383名患者随机分配至RFA组或标准治疗组（由外科医生偏好选择），主要分析采用改良意向性治疗。
AI.findings: 1. 术后第7天疼痛：RFA与标准治疗调整后均数差0.17（95% CI -0.67, 1.01），未显示优效性。2. 12个月复发率：RFA 47% vs 标准治疗39%，调整后绝对差7.4%（95% CI -5.3% to 20.1%），未证明非劣效性。3. 不良事件、症状严重程度、失禁、并发症等次要结局相当。4. RFA手术时间更短（均差9.1分钟），耗材成本更低，但患者误工天数更多（均差2.61天）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为RFA治疗痔疮的有效性提供了首个大规模随机对照试验证据，挑战了RFA优于标准治疗的假设，强调了在新技术广泛应用前进行严格评估的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结论不支持将RFA作为痔疮的常规治疗方案；为临床医生和卫生政策制定者提供了关于RFA成本效益的重要参考（手术成本降低但社会成本增加）。

title: Forecast-Skill Scarcity, Price Floors, and the Value of Weather Information in Solar-Saturated Electricity Markets
affiliations: University of Tokyo - The University of Tokyo and University of Tokyo

detail.title: Forecast-Skill Scarcity, Price Floors, and the Value of Weather Information in Solar-Saturated Electricity Markets
detail.abstract: How does the economic value of weather information in day-ahead price forecasting depend on forecast skill and on photovoltaic (PV) price-floor exposure? We study the Japan Electric Power Exchange, where nine areas share one market design but differ in PV penetration, on a daily-rolling walk-forward (n = 140 folds, September 2024–October 2025) with paired Diebold-Mariano tests and cluster-block bootstrap inference. A bid-close-admissible operational forecast carries large, broad weather value: on a common all-hours sample, exact-issuance JMA-GPV raises mean weather value about 7x over a reproducible lagged-reanalysis proxy and spreads it broadly. The apparent concentration of value in PV-floor regimes is an artefact of forecast-skill scarcity: a low-skill proxy extracts value only where the weather-to-price map is steep (the PV-floor channel), whereas a skilled forecast resolves demand and wind channels too and the concentration washes out. A threshold-crossing value-of-information model formalises this, reproduced by a controlled noise-degradation of the operational forecast. Two predetermined, non-price quantities pin the low-skill channel's location — the engineering PV/peak capacity ratio (Spearman -0.800) and a physical curtailment-to-FLOOR linkage (near-floor prices 19-96x likelier under PV curtailment; rho = +0.833) — with the price-derived FLOOR rate (rho = -0.733) an observable proxy. Operational skill is economically actionable through floor-event prediction (PR-AUC 0.37 to 0.59), cutting a short generator's realised JEPX imbalance exposure by about 177,000 JPY/MW/year — not battery arbitrage, where the marginal weather contribution is about zero. In solar-saturated markets weather's value is thus large, broad, and decision-relevant under operational skill; only its measured concentration is a skill-scarcity artefact.

AI.tldr: 本文研究日本电力市场（JEPX）中天气预报技能如何影响日前电价预测的经济价值，发现高技能预报的价值广泛分布而非集中于光伏价格地板区域，低技能预报的价值因技能稀缺而看似集中，实际是统计假象。
AI.research_question: 天气预报的经济价值如何依赖于预报技能以及光伏价格地板暴露程度？
AI.motivation: 随着光伏渗透率提高，天气预报对电力市场定价的重要性日益凸显，但天气价值是否集中于光伏价格地板时段、以及预报技能如何调节这一分布尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 阈值穿越信息价值模型（threshold-crossing value-of-information model）；Diebold-Mariano检验与聚类块自助法推断。
AI.method: 对日本9个区域进行每日滚动步行前向验证（n=140折，2024年9月至2025年10月），使用配对Diebold-Mariano检验和聚类块自助法，对比精确发布的JMA-GPV预报与滞后再分析代理变量，并通过受控噪声降解模拟低技能情境。
AI.findings: （1）高技能预报的天气价值约是低技能代理变量的7倍且分布广泛；（2）PV地板时段的价值集中是预报技能稀缺的统计假象；（3）低技能预报仅通过PV地板渠道提取价值，高技能预报还能解析需求与风电渠道；（4）工程PV/峰值容量比、弃光-地板价格联动等非价格指标可预测低技能渠道位置；（5）运营预报技能可改善地板事件预测（PR-AUC 0.37→0.59），为短头寸发电商减少约177,000日元/MW/年的JEPX不平衡暴露。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了"价值集中是技能稀缺假象"的理论解释，通过阈值穿越信息价值模型形式化了这一机制，区分了天气价值的存在与测量偏差。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电力市场参与者（尤其是光伏饱和地区的发电商和交易员）提供了天气预报技能的经济价值量化依据，表明改进预报技能可带来广泛而非局部套利的决策收益，且地板事件预测对风险管理具有直接经济意义。

title: Financial Inclusion, Fintech, and Financial Stability in Sub-Saharan Africa Using Alternative Models
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Financial Inclusion, Fintech, and Financial Stability in Sub-Saharan Africa Using Alternative Models
detail.abstract: The study comprehensively investigates the effects of changes primarily driven by relationships among financial inclusion, Fintech, and financial stability in Sub-Saharan Africa. We employ the Driscoll-Kraay Fixed Effects model, the Panel Fixed Effects regression model, and the Dynamic Panel Threshold model on the yearly data, spanning from 1st January 2004 to 31st December 2024. The study underscores the importance of Fintech and financial stability in achieving digital and stable financial inclusion in Sub-Saharan African economies. The results indicate that Fintech has a positive and statistically significant impact on financial inclusion in Sub-Saharan African economies, suggesting that It plays a crucial role by offering accessible, innovative digital financial solutions. Similarly, financial stability is positively influenced by economic development, enhancing financial inclusion, implying that a stable financial system increases public trust in banks and other financial services providers. These outcomes have significant implications, as they highlight how financial inclusion, Fintech, and financial stability are reshaping the financial services sector and contributing to the development and sustainability of the financial system.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了撒哈拉以南非洲地区金融包容性、金融科技与金融稳定性之间的关系，发现金融科技对金融包容性有显著正向影响，而金融稳定性通过经济发展促进金融包容性。
AI.research_question: 金融包容性、金融科技与金融稳定性之间在撒哈拉以南非洲地区的关系如何？
AI.motivation: 撒哈拉以南非洲地区金融包容性水平较低，金融科技的快速发展可能为此提供解决方案，但三者之间的复杂关系尚需系统实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融包容性理论、金融科技创新理论、金融稳定性理论
AI.method: 采用Driscoll-Kraay固定效应模型、面板固定效应回归模型和动态面板门槛模型，使用2004年1月1日至2024年12月31日的年度数据。
AI.findings: 金融科技对金融包容性有显著正向影响；经济发展通过增强金融稳定性促进金融包容性；金融稳定提升公众对银行的信任。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了金融科技、金融包容性与金融稳定性在撒哈拉以南非洲的互动机制，丰富了发展金融学在该区域的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了如何通过金融科技和金融稳定推动数字普惠金融发展的实证依据。

title: Bridging the Global Carbon Data Gap: A Systematic Transfer Learning Framework for Estimating Corporate Emissions
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST)

detail.title: Bridging the Global Carbon Data Gap: A Systematic Transfer Learning Framework for Estimating Corporate Emissions
detail.abstract: Accurate corporate carbon emissions data are essential for climate governance and sustainable investment, yet significant gaps persist across global markets. This study proposes a systematic transfer learning framework for corporate carbon emission estimation and benchmarks performance across 53 countries, six emission scopes, and multiple model families. Using firm-level data from Compustat and S&P Trucost, we compare local baselines, zero-shot global models, and transfer learning approaches. Our results reveal three findings. First, transfer learning effectiveness depends on local data availability: it outperforms local baselines in data-scarce markets (R̄² = 0.825 vs. 0.796; p = 0.003), while local models dominate when data are abundant. Second, transfer learning substantially improves upon zero-shot global models (R̄² = 0.822 vs. 0.626; p =1.2610⁻¹⁰), confirming that cross-country knowledge transfer requires local adaptation. Third, gains concentrate in Scope 3 downstream (Δ = +0.063, p = 0.007) and product-use emissions (Δ = +0.070, p = 0.009)—the most economically significant and difficult-to-measure categories. These findings offer a regime-aware decision rule for ESG data providers, regulators, and researchers seeking to close the global corporate carbon data gap.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个系统性的迁移学习框架用于估算企业碳排放，并在53个国家、六个排放范围及多种模型族中进行基准测试。研究发现迁移学习在数据稀缺市场中优于本地基线模型，零-shot全局模型需要本地适配才能有效，且改进主要集中在Scope 3下游和产品使用排放等最难测量的类别。
AI.research_question: 如何利用迁移学习框架有效估算全球企业碳排放，弥补不同市场之间的碳数据缺口？
AI.motivation: 全球企业碳排放数据存在显著缺失，阻碍了气候治理和可持续投资。现有模型在跨国、多排放范围场景下的性能缺乏系统性基准评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 迁移学习理论、零-shot学习、跨知识域自适应理论
AI.method: 使用Compustat和S&P Trucost的企业层面数据，比较本地基线模型、零-shot全局模型和迁移学习方法，覆盖53个国家、六个排放范围及多种模型族。
AI.findings: (1) 迁移学习在数据稀缺市场优于本地基线(R̄²=0.825 vs 0.796)，但数据充足时本地模型更优；(2) 迁移学习显著优于零-shot全局模型(R̄²=0.822 vs 0.626)，说明跨知识迁移需要本地适配；(3) 改进集中在Scope 3下游和产品使用排放等难测量类别。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个系统性评估迁移学习在全球碳排估算中效果的基准框架，揭示了数据可用性与模型选择之间的条件关系，验证了跨域知识迁移需要本地适配的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为ESG数据提供商、监管机构和研究人员提供了基于数据可用性的决策规则，帮助缩小全球企业碳数据缺口，改善碳排放估算的准确性和覆盖面。

title: Industrial Chain, Supply Chain and Value Chain in the Energy Industry: Opportunities and Challenges
affiliations: Wuhan Institute of Technology, University of Auckland Business School, China University of Geosciences Wuhan, China University of Geosciences Wuhan and University of Auckland Business School

detail.title: Industrial Chain, Supply Chain and Value Chain in the Energy Industry: Opportunities and Challenges
detail.abstract: Ongoing geopolitical conflicts, frequent energy trade wars, and related issues significantly undermine the globalization of the energy market. The pressing questions of today’s and tomorrow’s energy transformation revolve around expanding the energy industry’s industry chain, supply chain, and value chain, as well as enhancing the market-oriented distribution of energy through innovative and transformative approaches. Currently, data have emerged as a pivotal force driving economic growth, fueling the energy revolution, and propelling the advancement of digital technologies for the creation of a comprehensive global and regional energy market. This shift introduces fresh governance concepts, theories, methods, and models. The traditional energy system’s dual challenges of high demand and high emissions exacerbate ongoing coal-power conflicts and impede the market-based reform of oil and gas pipelines. With the rapid digitization of the energy sector and the challenges posed by integrating large-scale renewable energy sources, distributed power supply, and microgrids, there is an urgent need to adopt digital strategies to address the “impossible triangle” of ensuring energy security, economic growth, and efficiency. Thus, exploring digital governance within the energy sector’s industry, supply, and value chains is crucial. This exploration aims to enhance the efficiency of market factor allocation within the energy industry amid the digital economy’s swift expansion and address the broader issues of energy market reform and global integration. The full paper is available at https://doi.org/10.3390/en17061467

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在数字时代背景下，能源行业如何通过数字治理来应对地缘政治冲突、能源贸易战等挑战，解决能源安全、经济增长与效率之间的"不可能三角"，推动能源市场改革与全球一体化。
AI.research_question: 在数字经济快速发展的背景下，如何通过数字治理来优化能源行业的产业链、供应链和价值链，提升能源市场要素配置效率，并解决能源市场改革与全球一体化问题？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治冲突和能源贸易战削弱了能源市场全球化；传统能源系统面临高需求与高排放的双重挑战；大规模可再生能源、分布式电源和微电网的整合亟需数字化策略来应对能源安全、经济增长与效率之间的"不可能三角"。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字治理理论；能源市场改革理论；产业链、供应链、价值链"三链"协同理论；"不可能三角"（能源安全、经济增长、效率）理论框架。
AI.method: 概念性分析与理论探讨，基于现有文献和现实问题提出数字治理在能源领域的应用框架。
AI.findings: 数据已成为驱动经济增长、推动能源革命和数字技术发展的关键力量；数字治理能够为全球和区域能源市场提供全新的治理概念、理论、方法和模式；数字策略有助于解决能源领域的"不可能三角"难题。
AI.theory_contributions: 将数字治理理论系统引入能源行业研究，拓展了能源市场改革和全球一体化的理论视角；提出了数字时代能源行业"三链"协同治理的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为能源行业在数字经济背景下如何利用数字化手段提升市场要素配置效率、推动能源市场改革与全球一体化提供了实践方向和策略参考。

title: Dynamics between Energy Intensity and Carbon Emissions: What does the Clustering Effect of Labor and Capital Play?
affiliations: University of Auckland Business School, University of Auckland Business School, University of Auckland Business School, University of Auckland Business School and University of Auckland Business School

detail.title: Dynamics between Energy Intensity and Carbon Emissions: What does the Clustering Effect of Labor and Capital Play?
detail.abstract: Energy depletion and environmental degradation have emerged as pressing concerns in the era of China's highquality green economic development. We present an integrated framework that incorporate energy consumption intensity, industrial clustering, and carbon emissions into the STIRPAT framework. Our study examines 30 Chinese provinces from 2006 to 2017. Unlike previous analyses, our study measures industrial clustering from two dimensions: labor and capital clustering. Specifically, the benchmark results confirm that a 1% increase in energy consumption intensity will, on average, raise regional carbon emission intensity by 0.03389%. Moderating analysis shows that labor and capital clustering significantly lower carbon emission intensity by reducing energy consumption. These findings have been consolidated after performing a panel vector autoregressive model. Interestingly, the promoting effect of energy consumption intensity on carbon emission intensity tends to be tightened when labor clustering surpasses a threshold. In contrast, the corresponding effects substantially weaken after capital clustering exceeds a threshold. In all, these findings provide new evidence to understand the energy-emission nexus from an industrial clustering perspective. The full paper is available at https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jclepro.2024.142223

AI.tldr: 本文基于STIRPAT框架，将能源消费强度、产业集聚和碳排放纳入统一分析框架，利用2006-2017年中国30个省份的面板数据，从劳动力和资本集聚两个维度研究产业集聚如何调节能源消费强度与碳排放强度之间的关系。
AI.research_question: 产业集聚（劳动集聚和资本集聚）如何调节能源消费强度对碳排放强度的影响？
AI.motivation: 能源枯竭和环境退化已成为中国绿色经济高质量发展时代的紧迫问题，现有研究缺乏从产业集聚双维度（劳动与资本）视角探讨能源-排放关系的分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: STIRPAT框架（环境压力随机影响模型），结合产业集聚理论（劳动集聚与资本集聚）。
AI.method: 面板数据回归分析（2006-2017年中国30个省份数据）、调节效应分析、面板向量自回归模型（PVAR）稳健性检验、门槛效应分析。
AI.findings: 1. 能源消费强度每提高1%，区域碳排放强度平均上升0.03389%；2. 劳动集聚和资本集聚均通过降低能源消费显著降低碳排放强度；3. 劳动集聚超过门槛值后，能源消费强度对碳排放强度的促进作用增强；4. 资本集聚超过门槛值后，该效应则显著减弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将产业集聚分解为劳动集聚和资本集聚两个维度，纳入STIRPAT框架分析其对能源-排放关系的调节作用和门槛效应，丰富了能源经济学与环境经济学的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国绿色经济发展提供政策启示：通过引导资本集聚（而非单纯劳动集聚）来降低能源消费强度对碳排放的负面影响，为产业布局优化提供决策依据。

title: Nonlinear Subsidy Effectiveness, Path Dependence, and Hysteresis in Off-Grid Electricity Systems
affiliations: University of Saskatchewan, University of Saskatchewan, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Saskatchewan

detail.title: Nonlinear Subsidy Effectiveness, Path Dependence, and Hysteresis in Off-Grid Electricity Systems
detail.abstract: AbstractWe examine whether the effectiveness of the Power Cost Equalization (PCE) electricity subsidy program varies with fuel-price conditions in rural Alaska. Using a panel smooth transition regression model with a two-stage residual inclusion approach to address endogeneity and drawing on data from 96 utilities over 2006–2021, we find that the response to PCE is nonlinear and regime-dependent. A 1% increase in the PCE rate raises residential electricity sales by about 0.14% in the low-fuel-price regime but by 0.09% in the high-fuel-price regime. The estimated transition function further indicates that most utilities operate in the high-cost region, where the PCE primarily functions as a revenue-stabilization mechanism. We further show that fuel-price declines do not necessarily restore earlier levels of subsidy responsiveness. The path-dependence results indicate that fuel prices from two years earlier moderate the current PCE effect, while the hysteresis analysis shows that cumulative exposure to high-cost conditions creates persistent changes in subsidy responsiveness. These outcomes have important implications for the design and timing of subsidy reform, particularly regarding the roles of cost ceilings, benchmark rates, and complementary investments in reducing dependence on high-cost diesel generation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了阿拉斯加农村地区的电力成本均衡（PCE）补贴计划在不同燃料价格条件下的效果差异。研究发现补贴效应是非线性的：低油价时PCE每提高1%可增加0.14%的电力销售，高油价时仅增加0.09%。多数公用事业处于高成本区间，PCE主要起收入稳定作用。燃料价格下降不会恢复补贴敏感性，且存在路径依赖和滞后效应。
AI.research_question: 电力成本均衡（PCE）补贴计划的效果是否因燃料价格条件不同而存在差异？具体而言，在不同燃料价格体制下，PCE对居民电力销售的影响有何非线性特征？
AI.motivation: 阿拉斯加农村地区高度依赖高成本柴油发电，PCE补贴旨在降低居民电费负担。然而燃料价格波动剧烈，补贴效果可能因燃料成本环境不同而发生结构性变化。理解这种非线性关系对优化补贴设计和改革时机至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 面板平滑转换回归模型（PSTR）、两阶段残差包含法（2SRI）、路径依赖与滞后效应分析
AI.method: 采用面板平滑转换回归模型（PSTR），结合两阶段残差包含法（2SRI）处理内生性问题。数据涵盖2006-2021年阿拉斯加96家公用事业机构的运营数据。
AI.findings: 1. PCE效果具有非线性体制依赖性：低燃料价格体制下，PCE每提高1%使居民电力销售增加约0.14%；高燃料价格体制下仅增加约0.09%。2. 多数公用事业运行在高成本区间，此时PCE主要发挥收入稳定机制作用。3. 燃料价格下降不会自动恢复补贴敏感性，存在路径依赖：两年前的燃料价格会调节当前的PCE效果。4. 滞后效应分析表明，长期暴露于高成本条件会导致补贴响应发生持久性变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统揭示了电力补贴在燃料价格不同体制下的非线性效果差异，提出了PCE补贴在高成本区间的"收入稳定机制"新解释，并识别了补贴效果的路径依赖和滞后效应，丰富了能源补贴效果动态研究的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿拉斯加及类似依赖高成本柴油发电地区的电力补贴改革提供了重要政策启示：需要关注成本上限、基准费率的设计，以及通过互补性投资减少对高成本柴油发电的依赖。同时提醒政策制定者注意补贴改革时机的选择，因为燃料价格下降不会自动恢复补贴的原有效力。

reference: Energy Economics, 132, 107422. DOI:10.1016/j.eneco.2024.107422
title: Appraising the Role of Energy Conservation and Emission Reduction Policy for Eco-Friendly Productivity Improvements: An Entropy-Balancing DID Approach
affiliations: University of Auckland Business School, University of Auckland Business School, University of Auckland Business School and University of Auckland Business School

detail.title: Appraising the Role of Energy Conservation and Emission Reduction Policy for Eco-Friendly Productivity Improvements: An Entropy-Balancing DID Approach
detail.abstract: In pursuit of low-carbon and high-quality economic development, the Chinese government has implemented an energy conservation and emission reduction (ECER) policy. It has piloted this policy for three groups of prefecture-level cities since 2011. So far, there is no systematic evidence to demonstrate whether such a strategy can help China achieve a "win-win" situation between energy conservation and environmental protection. To identify the causal effect of the ECER policy on eco-friendly productivity (EFP), we explore variations in the timing of this policy across cities combined with the entropy-balancing method and assemble a balanced panel dataset encompassing China's 283 cities from 2006 to 2017. Empirical findings demonstrate that EFP in the ECER pilot cities had increased by 15.3% on average compared with EFP in non-ECER pilot regions based on the difference-indifferences framework. Notably, the ECER policy generates significant positive spatial spillover effects on surrounding ECER pilot regions. Our channel analysis confirms that the positive effect of the ECER policy is also realized through energy savings, structural effects, and green technological effects. Moreover, the observed effect is significantly heterogeneous regarding geographical locations, resource endowment, whether a city has an old industrial base, and environmental regulation. Finally, several policy implications concerning China's ECER policy and EFP improvement are put forward. The full paper is available at  https://doi.org/10.1016/j.eneco.2024.107422

AI.tldr: 本文利用2011年起中国实施的节能减排（ECER）政策在各地级市的试点时间差异，结合熵平衡法和双重差分模型，发现ECER政策使试点城市的生态友好型生产率（EFP）平均提高了15.3%，并产生正向空间溢出效应，其作用机制包括节能效应、结构效应和绿色技术效应。
AI.research_question: 中国节能减排（ECER）政策能否帮助实现节能与环保的"双赢"？其对生态友好型生产率（EFP）的因果效应如何？
AI.motivation: 尽管中国自2011年起分批在各地级市试点节能减排政策，但尚无系统性证据证明该策略能否实现节能与环保的"双赢"局面。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于节能减排政策与生态友好型生产率的因果识别框架，涉及节能效应、结构效应和绿色技术效应三条影响渠道。
AI.method: 利用政策在不同城市试点的时间差异，结合熵平衡法（entropy-balancing method）和双重差分模型（DID），采用2006-2017年中国283个地级市的面板数据。
AI.findings: （1）ECER政策使试点城市EFP平均提升15.3%；（2）政策对周边试点区域产生显著正向空间溢出效应；（3）节能效应、结构效应和绿色技术效应是主要作用机制；（4）效应在地理位置、资源禀赋、是否为老工业基地、环境规制强度等方面存在显著异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统评估了ECER政策对生态友好型生产率的因果效应，揭示了节能、结构和绿色技术三条影响机制，并证实了政策的正向空间溢出效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国节能减排政策的优化设计提供了实证依据，尤其是在政策推广、区域协同和差异化施策方面提出了具体的政策启示。

title: Productivity and Living Standards Are Not Everything: Reassessing Krugman's maxim
affiliations: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu - Deloitte Access Economics

detail.title: Productivity and Living Standards Are Not Everything: Reassessing Krugman's maxim
detail.abstract: Paul Krugman’s well-known claim that, in the long run, productivity is “almost everything” in determining living standards has become a central organising principle in economic policy debates. This paper argues that the maxim is only conditionally valid within a narrow accounting framework and becomes misleading when applied to real-world economies. Three critiques are developed. First, both productivity and living standards are incompletely measured, particularly through the omission of natural resources and non-market sector outputs. Second, productivity is an inadequate proxy for broader social welfare, which includes environmental sustainability, distributional outcomes, and non-market services. Third, the direction of causality is not one-way: living standards, demand conditions, and macroeconomic policy also shape productivity outcomes. The paper further shows that even within a conventional framework, other factors—including labour force participation, population dynamics, and net foreign income—make non-trivial contributions to long-run living standards. The central conclusion is that the apparent dominance of productivity is a feature of restrictive assumptions rather than a general property of economies. A productivity-centric policy framework is therefore incomplete. Policymakers should move beyond a productivity-centric framework toward a broader dashboard of economic and social indicators. Periods of weak productivity growth may reflect not only economic constraints but also socially optimal choices in mature economies.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了Krugman关于"生产率几乎决定一切"的论断，指出该论断仅在狭窄的核算框架下成立，在现实经济中会产生误导。文章从测量不完整、不能代表社会福利、因果关系不单向三个角度展开批判，并建议政策制定者超越生产率中心框架，采用更广泛的经济社会指标体系。
AI.research_question: Krugman关于"长期来看，生产率几乎决定生活水平"的论断在现实经济中是否仍然成立？其局限性在哪里？
AI.motivation: Krugman的论断已成为经济政策辩论的核心组织原则，但该论断可能过度简化了现实经济的复杂性，导致政策制定过度聚焦于生产率而忽视其他重要因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判性分析；国民收入核算框架；社会福利理论
AI.method: 理论批判与逻辑论证
AI.findings: 1. 生产率和生活水平的测量均不完整，忽略了自然资源和非市场部门产出；2. 生产率不足以代表社会福利，后者还包括环境可持续性、分配结果和非市场服务；3. 因果关系并非单向，生活水平、需求条件和宏观政策也会影响生产率；4. 即使在传统框架内，劳动参与率、人口动态和净外国收入等也会对生活水平产生显著贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了Krugman论断的局限性，指出"生产率主导"是限制性假设的结果而非经济的一般属性，为超越生产率中心主义的政策框架提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供建议：应超越生产率中心框架，采用更广泛的经济和社会指标体系；指出低生产率增长时期可能不仅反映经济约束，也可能是成熟经济体的社会最优选择。

reference: Transportation Research Part F: Traffic Psychology and Behaviour, 102, 125-141. DOI:10.1016/j.trf.2024.02.014
title: Analyzing Electric Vehicle users' Intention to use Dynamic Wireless Charging Facilities: A study from New Zealand
affiliations: University of Auckland, University of Auckland - Faculty of Engineering and University of Auckland Business School

detail.title: Analyzing Electric Vehicle users' Intention to use Dynamic Wireless Charging Facilities: A study from New Zealand

publicationDetails.detailsText: Transportation Research Part F: Traffic Psychology and Behaviour, 102, 125-141. DOI:10.1016/j.trf.2024.02.014

detail.abstract: Gaining insights into how users perceive dynamic wireless charging (DWC), also known as dynamic wireless power transfer (DWPT), technology for electric vehicle charging is crucial for developing effective measures and policies for its successful integration into the transportation network. This research paper presents a study conducted in New Zealand using an online stated preference survey and employing a structural equation modelling approach. The study investigates users' intention and acceptance of DWC technology, considering various latent factors, while incorporating attributes related to technology acceptance and the theory of planned behaviour in the modelling framework. The findings reveal that perceived concern negatively influences users' intention to use DWC facilities, while perceived usefulness in terms of ease of use and convenience, as well as environmental awareness and social norms, positively impact users' intention. These results offer valuable insights for devising strategies to enhance the acceptance of DWC technology in the future. The full paper is available at https://doi.org/10.1016/j.trf.2024.02.014

AI.tldr: 本文利用新西兰的在线陈述偏好调查和结构方程模型，探究用户对电动汽车动态无线充电（DWC/DWPT）技术的接受意愿，发现感知担忧负向影响使用意向，而感知有用性、环保意识和社会规范正向影响使用意向。
AI.research_question: 用户对动态无线充电（DWC）技术的使用意愿和接受度受哪些因素影响？
AI.motivation: 动态无线充电技术对电动汽车的普及和交通网络整合至关重要，但用户对这一新兴技术的感知和接受机制尚不明确，缺乏有效的策略指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术接受模型（TAM）与计划行为理论（TPB）相结合的框架。
AI.method: 在线陈述偏好调查（stated preference survey）与结构方程模型（SEM）分析。
AI.findings: （1）感知担忧（perceived concern）负向影响用户使用DWC的意愿；（2）感知有用性（易用性和便利性）、环保意识和社会规范正向影响用户使用意愿。
AI.theory_contributions: 将技术接受模型与计划行为理论整合应用于动态无线充电这一新兴技术场景，拓展了技术采纳理论在新能源交通基础设施领域的适用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和行业从业者提供了提升DWC技术接受度的具体策略方向，如降低用户感知担忧、突出易用性和环保价值，以及利用社会规范进行推广。

title: Does Energy Efficiency Influence House Prices? Evidence from Spain
affiliations: Banco de España and Universidad Carlos III de Madrid

detail.title: Does Energy Efficiency Influence House Prices? Evidence from Spain
detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the impact of energy efficiency on housing prices in Spain between 2015 and 2022. We fit a hedonic pricing model on more than one million transactions for which identification relies on within census-tract-quarter-year variation in Energy Performance Certificates, controlling for dwelling, location, and transaction characteristics. The results show that highly efficient homes (A–B) sell for 9.8% more than the least efficient ones (F–G), with the premium generally increasing over time. However, the capitalization of energy efficiency is heterogeneous: it is stronger for detached dwellings and weaker in tighter real estate markets. Climate effects are also non-linear. Higher heating needs increase the price premium with respect to the least efficient homes, except for the most efficient dwellings. On the other hand, lower cooling needs are associated with larger price premiums only for highly efficient dwellings. Overall, the results suggest that the valuation of energy efficiency depends on property characteristics, market conditions and climate, rather than reflecting a uniform cost-savings mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文利用西班牙2015-2022年间超过100万笔交易数据，通过特征价格模型分析能源效率对房价的影响，发现高效住宅（A-B级）比低效住宅（F-G级）贵9.8%，但这种溢价因房产类型、市场环境和气候条件而异。
AI.research_question: 能源效率对西班牙住房价格有何影响？这种影响是否因房产特征、市场条件和气候因素而异？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对能源效率资本化效应的研究多为单一市场或国家层面，缺乏对不同房产类型、市场环境和气候条件下异质性效应的系统分析。西班牙作为欧洲第四大经济体，拥有丰富的气候多样性，为研究能源效率溢价的条件依赖性提供了理想场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 特征价格理论（Hedonic Pricing Model），该理论认为商品价格由其所包含的一系列特征的隐含价格决定，能源效率作为房产特征之一应被资本化到房价中。
AI.method: 特征价格模型（Hedonic Pricing Model），利用西班牙2015-2022年超过100万笔交易数据，识别策略依赖于同一人口普查区-季度-年份内能源绩效证书（EPC）的变异，控制了房产、区位和交易特征。
AI.findings: （1）高效住宅（A-B级）比低效住宅（F-G级）售价高9.8%，且溢价随时间递增；（2）溢价存在异质性：独立式住宅溢价更强，房地产市场紧张地区溢价较弱；（3）气候效应呈非线性：供暖需求越高，溢价越大（对最高效住宅除外）；制冷需求越低，仅对高效住宅溢价更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了能源效率资本化的条件依赖性，证明能源效率溢价并非统一的成本节约机制反映，而是取决于房产特征、市场条件和气候环境的共同作用，丰富了特征价格理论在能源效率领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为房地产投资者、政策制定者和购房者提供了能源效率价值评估的参考依据；提示政策制定者在推广建筑节能改造时应考虑区域市场条件和气候差异，制定差异化激励政策。

reference: Journal of cleaner production, 441, 140861. DOI:10.1016/j.jclepro.2024.140861
title: Modelling the Role of Industrial Structure Adjustment on China's Energy Efficiency: Insights from Technology Innovation
affiliations: University of Auckland Business School, University of Auckland Business School, University of Auckland Business School and University of Auckland Business School

detail.title: Modelling the Role of Industrial Structure Adjustment on China's Energy Efficiency: Insights from Technology Innovation
detail.abstract: Due to uncoordinated economic progress, China's regional gap concerning energy efficiency (EE) is noticeable. However, industrial structure adjustments can be reorganized as a promising way to prioritize the green and lowcarbon transition. Aiming to understand how regional EE can be achieved through industrial structure adjustment, this study empirically investigates the role of industrial structure adjustment in increasing interprovincial EE from a technology innovation perspective. Unlike previous studies, the primary analytical framework is anchored on a spatio-temporal domain. Specifically, we observe that industrial structure rationalization and industrial structure adjustment not only directly influence local EE but also indirectly exert a positive effect on EE improvements in adjacent provinces. The same implications are also valid when addressing the EE-ICT nexus. Further mechanism analysis shows that technology innovation positively moderates industrial structure adjustment to EE enhancements, with regional heterogeneity being all-important. We find that the non-linear effect of industrial structure adjustment on EE is conditioned by technology innovation. Increasing R&D input intensity could significantly change the impacts of industrial structure adjustments on EE efficiency. The full paper is available at https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jclepro.2024.140861

AI.tldr: 本研究从时空视角出发，实证分析了产业结构调整（合理化与高级化）如何通过技术创新机制提升中国省际能源效率。研究发现，产业结构调整不仅直接提升本地能源效率，还通过空间溢出效应促进邻近省份的能效改善；技术创新正向调节这一关系，且存在区域异质性；研发投入强度能显著改变产业结构调整对能效的影响方向或程度。
AI.research_question: 产业结构调整如何影响中国省际能源效率？技术创新在其中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 中国区域间能源效率差距显著，而产业结构调整被视为推动绿色低碳转型的 promising 途径，但现有研究缺乏从时空视角探讨产业结构调整对能效的空间溢出效应及技术创新调节机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间经济学、技术创新理论、产业经济学中的产业结构合理化与高级化理论
AI.method: 基于时空分析框架的实证研究，采用空间计量模型探讨产业结构调整对能效的直接效应、空间溢出效应，以及技术创新的调节效应和非线性影响。
AI.findings: 产业结构合理化和高级化不仅直接提升本地能效，还通过空间溢出正向影响邻近省份能效；技术创新正向调节产业结构调整对能效的提升作用；存在显著的区域异质性；产业结构调整对能效的影响存在基于技术创新的非线性效应，研发投入强度是关键条件变量。
AI.theory_contributions: 将产业结构调整与能源效率的研究从传统非空间视角拓展到时空分析框架，揭示了产业结构调整对能效的空间溢出机制；引入技术创新作为调节变量，发现其非线性调节效应，丰富了产业升级与绿色发展的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供区域协同视角下的产业结构调整路径建议，强调通过提升研发投入强度来释放产业结构调整的能效红利，并注意区域差异化施策。

title: Governing AI Risk in High-Stakes Deal Environments: Who Controls the Evidence Layer?

detail.title: Governing AI Risk in High-Stakes Deal Environments: Who Controls the Evidence Layer?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no personal, financial, or organizational competing interests to declare. No relationships or activities influenced the research or its conclusions.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental procedures requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency, commercial entity, or not‑for‑profit organization.

detail.abstract:
AI regulation is an area of active, rapid legislative change; readers should verify all dated regulatory claims against current legal sources before relying on them.

Agentic and autonomous AI systems are now embedded across the entire M&A lifecycle - from deal sourcing and diligence through valuation, negotiation, closing, and integration execution. In high‑stakes deal environments, where fiduciary duties, valuation accuracy, regulatory scrutiny, and litigation exposure converge, the evidentiary obligations that attach to AI‑assisted decision‑making remain poorly understood.

Under the EU AI Act and equivalent global frameworks, deployers rather than vendors bear accountability for how AI systems operate in their name, and this responsibility cannot be transferred contractually. Parallel obligations arise under long‑standing legal frameworks that predate AI regulation. Courts and tribunals assessing AI‑assisted decisions focus on reconstructability, human oversight, and professional verification duties. Recent cases across Canada, England, and the US confirm that organisations relying on AI output must evidence what the system did, how human decision‑makers engaged with it, and whether oversight met professional standards.

This paper argues that control of the orchestration layer determines what evidence can be produced across all phases of M&A, and thereby determines deployer liability when AI‑assisted decisions are challenged. Vendor indemnities, representation and warranty insurance, and contractual disclaimers do not address deployer liability under Article 26 or its global equivalents. Drawing on comparative regulatory analysis, cross‑framework mapping, and a working proof‑of‑concept prototype, the paper proposes a layered governance architecture for agentic AI across the full M&A lifecycle, aligned with the EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework. It introduces a model-diverse defensive architecture designed to mitigate adversarial prompt risks through independent validation loops, and demonstrates how architectural choice dictates an organisation’s capacity to satisfy non-delegable evidentiary obligations when AI‑assisted deal decisions are contested.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨在欧盟《人工智能法案》等全球监管框架下，并购全流程中使用智能自主AI系统的部署者责任。作者提出，对AI编排层的控制决定了组织能否满足不可转移的举证义务，并构建了一套覆盖并购全生命周期的分层治理架构和防御性设计，以应对AI辅助决策被质疑时的法律风险。
AI.research_question: 在并购全生命周期中，当AI辅助决策受到法律挑战时，部署者（而非供应商）应承担何种举证责任？编排层的架构选择如何决定组织满足不可转移的举证义务的能力？
AI.motivation: AI系统已深度嵌入并购流程（从交易寻源到整合执行），但在高风险的交易环境中（涉及信义义务、估值准确性、监管审查和诉讼风险），AI辅助决策的举证义务尚不明确。现有合同法机制（供应商赔偿、陈述与保证保险等）无法解决欧盟AI Act第26条下的部署者责任。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟AI Act第26条（部署者责任不可转移）；ISO/IEC 42001（AI管理体系）；NIST AI风险管理框架；不可转移的举证义务（non-delegable evidentiary obligations）；可重构性（reconstructability）、人工监督（human oversight）与专业验证义务（professional verification duties）的法律标准。
AI.method: 比较监管分析（欧盟、加拿大、英国、美国）；跨框架映射（AI Act、ISO 42001、NIST AI RMF）；概念验证原型（proof-of-concept prototype）。
AI.findings: (1) 部署者对AI系统运作的问责不可通过合同转移给供应商；(2) 法院和仲裁庭在审查AI辅助决策时聚焦于可重构性、人工监督和专业验证义务；(3) 编排层的控制决定了组织能否产生必要证据；(4) 提出了一种模型多样性防御架构（model-diverse defensive architecture），通过独立验证环路降低对抗性提示风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将欧盟AI Act的部署者责任条款与并购流程中的举证义务相链接；提出了"编排层控制决定举证能力"的分析框架；识别了合同机制在解决部署者责任方面的根本性局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为并购从业者提供了分层治理架构设计和防御性验证机制的具体方案；帮助组织理解并满足不可转移的举证义务；为AI辅助并购决策的法律合规提供了可操作的技术与治理建议。

title: Algorithmic Echelons: The Organization as a Reflection of Its Top Decision Systems
affiliations: University of Oxford

detail.title: Algorithmic Echelons: The Organization as a Reflection of Its Top Decision Systems
detail.abstract: Upper echelons theory holds that organizational outcomes reflect the cognitions, values, and experiences of top managers. Yet algorithmic systems increasingly shape what executives see, how they interpret it, and which alternatives they consider. The strategic apex of the firm is no longer purely human. I reconceptualize the upper echelon as an algorithmic echelon: a hybrid decision-making structure in which human executives and algorithmic systems jointly produce strategic cognition, choice, and outcomes. I identify four mechanisms through which algorithmic systems reconfigure upper echelons theory's central constructs—cognitive substitution, attentional mediation, interpretive opacity, and delegation re-architecture—and derive four propositions specifying when algorithmic echelons amplify, distort, or substitute for the strategic cognition of human top managers. This paper reformulates upper echelons theory's scope conditions for an era of algorithmic organizing and introduces hybrid strategic cognition as a focal construct for strategic leadership research.

AI.tldr: 本文重新概念化了高层梯队理论，提出"算法梯队"——人类高管与算法系统共同构成混合决策结构，通过四种机制重塑战略认知、选择与结果。
AI.research_question: 算法系统如何改变高层梯队理论中关于组织结果反映高层管理者认知、价值观和经验的核心假设？
AI.motivation: 高层梯队理论认为组织结果反映高管的认知和价值观，但算法系统日益塑造高管的所见、所思和所择，战略顶层不再是纯粹的人类领域，现有理论需要更新其边界条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 高层梯队理论、算法组织理论、混合战略认知
AI.method: 理论研究（概念性论文），通过机制识别和命题推导构建理论框架
AI.findings: 识别了四种机制：认知替代、注意力中介、解释不透明性和委托重构；提出当算法梯队放大、扭曲或替代人类高层管理者战略认知时的四个命题；引入"混合战略认知"作为核心构念。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新界定了高层梯队理论在算法时代的适用条件；提出了"算法梯队"和"混合战略认知"两个新构念，拓展了战略领导力研究的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒管理者注意算法系统如何在认知层面影响战略决策，以及何时算法可能放大或扭曲人类判断，帮助企业更好地设计人与算法协同的战略决策结构。

title: Above-the-Loop Governance: A Statistical Architecture for Verifying and Allocating Decision Authority in Deployed AI Systems

detail.title: Above-the-Loop Governance: A Statistical Architecture for Verifying and Allocating Decision Authority in Deployed AI Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author founded and serves as Director of Trakked Pty Ltd, which operationalises the architecture described in this paper as a deployable governance system. The evaluation framework set out in Sections 2 and 10 is offered as a neutral instrument applicable to every provider claiming the category, and the author holds that any system he builds should be tested against it as rigorously as any other. Readers should weigh the argument of this paper on its merits and against the published framework. A provisional patent application covering certain methods referred to in this paper was filed in May and updated in June 2026 and is pending.
declarations.funderStatement: This work received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence systems increasingly make consequential decisions at a volume and velocity beyond human review and increasingly hold authority over those decisions rather than offering recommendations a human weighs. The dominant oversight model, the placement of a human in the decision flow, was designed for a different scale and is now constrained by documented cognitive limitations and by an economic structure whose cost grows linearly with deployment. This paper defines above-the-loop governance: a class of architecture in which qualified human professional judgement is not embedded in the per-decision flow but is held as a continuously measured benchmark against which an AI system's judgements are verified, using statistical methods established over more than half a century in clinical research, regulated manufacturing, and population-grade measurement. The architecture's defining economic property is that the human benchmark scales with statistical sufficiency rather than with AI volume, so the unit cost of governance falls as deployment grows under stable conditions. The paper extends the architecture in three respects: it anchors the human benchmark to externally established professional and regulatory standards, addressing the circularity of an organisation measuring itself; it introduces an authority layer that allocates decision authority between human and machine on measured evidence rather than by default; and it specifies the graded, accountable, measurement-verified response that must follow when divergence is detected. The paper situates the architecture explicitly within the scalable oversight literature of AI safety research and the post-deployment monitoring literature of regulated industries, states the assumptions and limits of each claim, offers a ten-criterion framework by which any system claiming the category should be evaluated.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"above-the-loop governance"的人工智能治理架构，核心思路是将人类专业判断从逐决策流程中抽离，作为持续测量的基准，通过统计方法验证AI系统的判断，从而实现治理成本随部署规模扩大而下降。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种可扩展的AI治理架构，使其在AI系统以高速度和大规模做出自主决策时，仍能保持有效的人类监督？
AI.motivation: 传统"人在环中"（human-in-the-loop）的监督模式在认知局限性和经济成本上存在瓶颈——人类认知能力有限，且监督成本随AI部署规模线性增长，无法适应AI系统日益增长的决策速度和体量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统计过程控制理论、临床研究和受控制造中的统计验证方法、可扩展监督（scalable oversight）文献、受监管行业的事后监测（post-deployment monitoring）文献。
AI.method: 概念设计与理论建构。作者定义了"above-the-loop"架构的组成要素，并将其锚定于外部专业和监管标准，引入基于测量证据的权责分配层，以及分级、可问责、经测量验证的响应机制。
AI.findings: 该架构的经济特性是：人类基准的成本随统计充分性（而非AI决策量）增长，因此在稳定条件下，治理的单位成本随部署规模扩大而下降。论文还提出了一个十项标准评估框架，用于评判任何声称属于该类别的系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 将临床研究、受控制造业和人口级测量领域成熟的统计方法引入AI治理，弥合了可扩展监督文献与受监管行业事后监测文献之间的差距，为AI安全研究提供了新的架构性思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI系统的大规模部署提供了一种可操作的、经济可行的治理方案，使人类监督从每决策的成本中心转变为可规模化的质量保证机制，并给出了具体的评估标准。

title: From Mining to Meaning: How Do Blockchain Infrastructure Platforms Respond to Environmental Sustainability Concerns?
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST), Hong Kong University of Science and Technology - Department of Accounting, Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) and Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

detail.title: From Mining to Meaning: How Do Blockchain Infrastructure Platforms Respond to Environmental Sustainability Concerns?
detail.abstract: Environmental sustainability is a critical concern in IT infrastructure governance, yet its implications for blockchain infrastructure platforms (BIPs), such as Bitcoin, remain insufficiently understood. We first provide evidence that Tesla’s 2021 suspension of Bitcoin payments due to its negative environmental impact increased investor awareness of BIPs’ environmental impacts. Consistent with nonpecuniary preference theory in behavioral finance, we find that BIPs, especially energy-intensive proof-of-work-based platforms, experience losses in token valuations following the suspension. We further show that, after the suspension, investors value environmental disclosures more positively, and BIPs substantially increase environmental disclosures. Our findings highlight investor awareness as a potential policy lever for mitigating blockchain infrastructures’ environmental impacts.

AI.tldr: 本文研究特斯拉2021年因环保原因暂停比特币支付的事件如何提升投资者对区块链基础设施平台环境影响的关注，并导致能源密集型平台代币价值下跌，同时促使平台增加环境信息披露。
AI.research_question: 区块链基础设施平台的环境可持续性问题如何影响投资者行为和平台估值？
AI.motivation: 环境可持续性是IT基础设施治理中的关键问题，但区块链基础设施平台（如比特币）的环境影响尚未被充分理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学中的非金钱偏好理论（nonpecuniary preference theory）
AI.method: 事件研究法，分析特斯拉2021年暂停比特币支付事件前后的市场反应和披露变化
AI.findings: 1) 特斯拉暂停事件提高了投资者对BIPs环境影响的关注；2) 能源密集型工作量证明（PoW）平台代币估值遭受更大损失；3) 事件后投资者更正面评价环境信息披露；4) BIPs大幅增加了环境信息披露。
AI.theory_contributions: 将非金钱偏好理论扩展到区块链基础设施领域，证明环境偏好会影响投资者对加密资产的估值。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出投资者关注度可作为减轻区块链基础设施环境影响的政策杠杆，为监管和平台治理提供参考。

title: Plant Seedlings Classification using CNN: A Comparative Model Report

detail.title: Plant Seedlings Classification using CNN: A Comparative Model Report

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial or personal interests that could appear to influence the model report or its findings.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human participants or personally identifiable data were involved in this study, and therefore ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This project did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Agricultural modernization requires automated solutions for plant species identification to reduce manual labor and improve crop management efficiency. This work presents a deep learning framework for classifying plant seedlings into 12 species categories using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). The dataset, sourced from Aarhus University in collaboration with the University of Southern Denmark, contains 4,750 RGB images of plant seedlings. A baseline CNN model was developed and subsequently enhanced through data augmentation, learning rate scheduling, and early stopping techniques. The final augmented model achieved 88.5% training accuracy, 88.8% validation accuracy, and 84.8% test accuracy with a weighted F1-score of 0.851. The model demonstrates strong classification performance across most species, with particularly high accuracy for Fat Hen (94.7%), Maize (93.6%), and Sugar beet (93.2%). These results demonstrate the feasibility of automated plant identification for agricultural applications, offering potential labor savings and improved crop management efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于CNN的深度学习框架，用于将植物幼苗分类为12个物种类别，最终增强模型在测试集上达到84.8%的准确率和0.851的加权F1分数，证明了自动化植物识别的可行性。
AI.research_question: 如何利用深度学习（特别是CNN）实现对植物幼苗的自动化、高精度分类？
AI.motivation: 农业现代化需要自动化植物物种识别解决方案，以减少人工劳动并提高作物管理效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 卷积神经网络（CNN）、数据增强、学习率调度、早停法。
AI.method: 使用来自奥胡斯大学和南丹麦大学的4,750张RGB图像数据集；构建基线CNN模型；通过数据增强、学习率调度和早停法进行优化。
AI.findings: 增强模型训练准确率88.5%，验证准确率88.8%，测试准确率84.8%，加权F1分数0.851；对Fat Hen（94.7%）、Maize（93.6%）和Sugar beet（93.2%）分类效果最佳。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了基础CNN结合数据增强、学习率调度和早停等技巧在植物幼苗分类任务中的有效性，为农业AI应用提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种可行的自动化植物幼苗识别方案，有望减少农业中的人工识别劳动，提高作物管理效率。

title: Efficiency or Distribution: The Hidden Tradeoff in the AI Layoff Trap
affiliations: Showa Women's University

detail.title: Efficiency or Distribution: The Hidden Tradeoff in the AI Layoff Trap

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no personal or financial relationships with other people or organizations that could be perceived to have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a theoretical analysis and does not involve human participants, animals, or personal data. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Hemenway Falk and Tsoukalas (2026) showed that competing firms overautomate because each firm captures the full cost savings from replacing a worker while bearing only part of the demand destroyed by its layoffs. The authors treat this overautomation as a single efficiency loss. This study separates that loss into two margins, the excess automation itself and a shift of real purchasing power from workers to owners, and studies how owner spending affects each. We add one parameter, the fraction of profit that owners spend in the sector, and measure distribution by owners' real consumption share rather than by a planner's chosen weight. The central result is that the parameter that shrinks the overautomation wedge also increases the owners' real consumption share. Improving efficiency through owner spending worsens distribution because that spending returns to owners and, against fixed output, increases prices that erode workers' purchasing power. We also show that congestion in reabsorption enlarges the demand externality and that more productive AI reproduces the same tension. Correcting both the inefficiency and income shift requires an automation tax paired with redistribution, not a tax alone.

AI.tldr: 本文在Hemenway Falk和Tsoukalas（2026）的基础上，将企业过度自动化的效率损失拆分为两个维度——过度自动化本身和购买力从工人向所有者的转移，并研究所有者支出如何影响二者。核心发现是：缩小过度自动化扭曲的参数反而会恶化分配，因为所有者支出通过价格上涨侵蚀工人购买力，纠正需要自动化税加再分配的组合政策。
AI.research_question: 企业过度自动化带来的效率损失如何分解为过度自动化本身和购买力转移两个部分？所有者支出对这两个部分分别产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 既有文献将过度自动化视为单一效率损失，但这一损失实际上包含自动化过度导致的资源配置扭曲，以及购买力从工人向所有者转移带来的分配问题。本研究旨在分离这两个维度，并考察所有者支出如何影响效率与分配之间的权衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 需求外部性理论；自动化与劳动力替代模型；收入分配与价格传导机制
AI.method: 理论建模：在既有模型基础上引入一个参数——所有者在该部门的支出比例，并用所有者的实际消费份额（而非计划者的权重）衡量分配状况，分析该参数对过度自动化楔子和分配的影响。
AI.findings: （1）缩小过度自动化扭曲的参数会同时增加所有者的实际消费份额，即效率改善以分配恶化为代价；（2）所有者支出回流到所有者自身，在产出固定的情况下推高价格，侵蚀工人购买力；（3）再吸收过程中的拥堵效应会扩大需求外部性；（4）更高生产率的人工智能复制了同样的效率-分配张力；（5）纠正双重问题需要自动化税搭配再分配政策，而非仅征税。
AI.theory_contributions: 将过度自动化的效率损失分解为过度自动化楔子和购买力转移两个边际，揭示效率改善与分配恶化之间的内在权衡机制，丰富了自动化经济学的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：单纯征收自动化税无法同时解决效率和分配问题，必须搭配再分配政策（如转移支付）才能有效应对自动化带来的社会挑战。

title: Paradoxes and Conundrums in the U.S. Higher Education and their Resolution

detail.title: Paradoxes and Conundrums in the U.S. Higher Education and their Resolution

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not Applicable
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: Paradoxes are phenomena where the opposites appear to be at once true. When they occur in societies, they tend to precipitate resolution paralysis, or in the worst-case scenario, destruction of either or both of the involved opposites. Furthermore, paradoxes do not develop overnight or arise out of the blue. Lastly, paradoxes are often resistant to incremental trajectory-correction solutions and require paradigm shifts. Higher education in the U.S. is currently besieged by at least four paradoxes, creating a between Scylla and Charybdis1 kind of catch-22 situation, probably because it has morphed into a hard to disentangle education-industry complex. We already have an ocean of information at our disposal as the global Internet connectivity is becoming ubiquitous. Further, the dawn of the age of artificial intelligence (AI) has arrived that has a potential to make knowledge synthesis easy and trustworthy. In that context, rather than undertake an onerous task of tackling the problems in the U.S. higher education with small incremental fixes, it might be more efficient to reinvent the system totally. This white paper, enlists the paradoxes, defines the purpose of higher education, elucidates three but not the only major undercurrents that compromise education, and offers a diagnosis and a solution to the problem.

AI.tldr: 本文指出美国高等教育面临至少四重悖论，陷入类似"斯库拉与卡律布狄斯"的两难困境，认为渐进式修补已无效，提出应借助AI时代的技术条件彻底重塑高等教育体系。
AI.research_question: 美国高等教育面临哪些悖论？如何通过系统性变革而非渐进式修补来应对这些悖论？
AI.motivation: 美国高等教育已演变为难以解开的"教育-产业复合体"，面临多重悖论导致的决策瘫痪。随着全球互联网普及和AI时代的到来，知识合成变得容易且可信，这使得重新审视并彻底改革高等教育体系成为可能且必要的时机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 悖论理论：当对立双方似乎同时为真时，会引发解决瘫痪，甚至导致一方或双方被摧毁；悖论非一日形成，且通常需要范式转移而非渐进式修正才能解决。
AI.method: 白皮书性质的理论分析与诊断：列举悖论、界定高等教育目的、阐明三大主要暗流（undercurents），并提供诊断与解决方案。
AI.findings: 美国高等教育至少存在四重悖论，形成类似"斯库拉与卡律布狄斯"的Catch-22困境；存在至少三大损害教育的暗流；渐进式的轨迹修正已失效，需要范式层面的彻底重塑。
AI.theory_contributions: 将悖论理论应用于高等教育领域，论证了当社会系统陷入多重悖论时，渐进式解决方案的无效性以及范式转移的必要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和教育管理者提供了一份诊断报告：明确指出美国高等教育当前困境的根源在于多重悖论交织，并建议利用AI时代的条件进行系统性重构而非零敲碎打的改革。

title: The Regulatory Waterbed: Unilateral Leverage Caps and the Contamination of a Shared Perpetual-Futures Settlement Index

detail.title: The Regulatory Waterbed: Unilateral Leverage Caps and the Contamination of a Shared Perpetual-Futures Settlement Index
detail.abstract: A unilateral leverage cap on perpetual-futures contracts that are cash-settled against a shared, manipulable index can raise systemic fragility while lowering total leverage and fire-sale risk. Tightening pushes leverage to opaque offshore venues, where it degrades the shared settlement price. The harm falls on onshore positions that never moved yet settle against that price.
