title: Tear Down This Wall: Rethinking the Separation of Banking and Commerce
affiliations: George Mason University - Antonin Scalia Law School

detail.title: Tear Down This Wall: Rethinking the Separation of Banking and Commerce

publicationDetails.detailsText: International Center for Law & Economics, White Paper, 2026-06-24
George Mason Law & Economics Research Paper No. 26-13
publicationDetails.journalName: Antonin Scalia Law School, George Mason University, Law & Economics Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
For more than a century, the United States has sought to separate banking and commerce. The impulse was largely political, not economic: a distinctly American distrust of concentrated economic power and a fear that control over credit could dominate local economies, distort markets, and threaten democratic governance. In response to banking crises, industrial consolidation, and the rise of large financial institutions, policymakers built structural rules to keep financial and commercial power apart.

This paper argues that those rationales belong to an earlier era of fragmented local banking markets, geographic restrictions, and limited competition. Even then, forcing economic forces and consumer demand into arbitrary legal categories was a losing battle. Today, the project is even less realistic. Interstate banking, embedded finance, platform economics, banking-as-a-service, and emerging technologies such as agentic artificial intelligence have transformed financial intermediation and increased demand for integrated financial and commercial services.

The wall between banking and commerce is now increasingly leaky and asymmetric. Technology companies perform quasi-banking functions, while regulated banks often serve as infrastructure providers within broader digital ecosystems. At the same time, regulators have more sophisticated supervisory tools than ever before to address risks without preserving an archaic and anticompetitive structure.

Financial regulation should therefore move away from rigid categorical separation and toward principles-based oversight focused on conduct, interoperability, competition, systemic risk, and consumer protection. Rather than prohibit integration outright, policymakers should regulate the specific behaviors and risks associated with platform finance and modern financial intermediation. The question is no longer whether banking and commerce should interact. They already do. The question is how best to govern that interaction while preserving competition, innovation, financial stability, and consumer choice.

AI.tldr: 本文论证美国传统的银行业与商业分离政策已过时。随着跨州银行、嵌入式金融、平台经济和人工智能等新业态的发展，银商融合已不可逆转。监管应从“刚性分类隔离”转向“基于原则的监管”，聚焦行为、互操作性、竞争、系统性风险和消费者保护。
AI.research_question: 美国银行业与商业分离的监管政策在当前经济和科技环境下是否仍然合理？应当如何改革？
AI.motivation: 美国长达一个多世纪的银商分离政策源于对权力集中的政治不信任，但当今的金融中介形态（如嵌入式金融、BaaS、AI代理）已使这种分离越来越不现实，监管框架亟需更新。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融监管理论、竞争理论、系统性风险理论、消费者保护理论；区分“基于实体的分类监管”与“基于行为/功能的原则监管”。
AI.method: 法律与经济学分析，历史制度分析，结合当代金融科技发展（嵌入式金融、平台经济、银行即服务、代理型AI）进行制度变迁论证。
AI.findings: （1）银商隔离墙已漏洞百出且不对称——科技公司从事准银行功能，银行沦为数字生态中的基础设施提供者；（2）现代监管工具已足以管控风险，无需保留过时的结构分离；（3）应转向原则导向的监管框架，聚焦行为、竞争、系统性风险和消费者保护。
AI.theory_contributions: 批判和更新了“银商分离”的理论基础，提出从“分类隔离”范式向“原则监管”范式的理论转换，为金融监管制度设计提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国及其他国家的金融监管改革提供政策建议：放弃刚性分离，转向行为与风险导向的监管；指导如何治理平台金融与现代金融中介中的银商互动。

title: Transient and Persistent Effects of Fertilizer and Pesticide Use on Technical Efficiency: Evidence from the Italian Olive Sector
affiliations: University of Calabria,  and University of Calabria

detail.title: Transient and Persistent Effects of Fertilizer and Pesticide Use on Technical Efficiency: Evidence from the Italian Olive Sector

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: Global food production faces increasing pressure from growing demand, climate change, and limited land availability. In this context, fertilizers and pesticides remain central to agricultural intensification, yet their contribution to productivity remains uncertain. Existing studies generally assess the effects of chemical inputs through yield responses without distinguishing between temporary gains and more persistent changes in productive capacity. This study investigates the relationship between chemical input use and technical efficiency, distinguishing between short-and long-term effects. Using farm-level data from Italian olive farms over the period 2008-2022, we apply a stochastic frontier analysis that separates transient from persistent inefficiency, allowing the identification of short-lived versus structural determinants of efficiency. Results indicate that both fertilizers and pesticides are positively associated with transient technical efficiency. However, while the effect of fertilizers becomes statistically insignificant for persistent efficiency, pesticides exhibit a negative association with long-term efficiency. This pattern is consistent with cumulative ecological impacts affecting productive capacity over time. The findings suggest that productivity gains from chemical inputs may differ in their persistence and highlight the importance of balancing short-term production objectives with long-term sustainability.

AI.tldr: 本文利用意大利橄榄农场2008-2022年的数据，通过随机前沿分析区分化肥和农药对短期技术效率与长期技术效率的不同影响。研究发现，化肥和农药均能提升短期效率，但农药对长期效率有负面影响，而化肥的长期效应则不显著。
AI.research_question: 化肥和农药的使用如何影响农业生产的短期技术效率与长期技术效率？
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常只评估化学投入对产量的短期影响，忽略了其可能对生产能力产生持续性变化的长期效应。在粮食需求增长、气候变化和土地资源有限背景下，澄清化学投入短期与长期不同的效率效应，对平衡生产目标与可持续发展至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机前沿分析（Stochastic Frontier Analysis），区分暂时性低效率（transient inefficiency）与持续性低效率（persistent inefficiency）的模型框架。
AI.method: 采用能够分离暂时性和持续性低效率的随机前沿分析方法，使用2008-2022年意大利橄榄农场的面板数据。
AI.findings: （1）化肥和农药均与短期技术效率正相关；（2）化肥对长期效率的影响在统计上不显著；（3）农药与长期效率呈负相关，符合累积生态影响损害长期生产能力的假设。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在区分短期与长期技术效率的框架下，系统检验化肥和农药对农业生产效率的不同时间维度效应，揭示了化学投入对生产能力的异质性影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为农业生产者与政策制定者提供了重要启示：应警惕农药对长期生产能力的累积负面影响，在追求短期产出目标的同时需重视生态可持续性，推动更平衡的化学投入管理策略。

title: Does Brand Equity Affect Perceived Drug Safety?
affiliations: University of Illinois at Chicago - College of Business Administration, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign - Gies College of Business and Johns Hopkins University - Carey Business School

detail.title: Does Brand Equity Affect Perceived Drug Safety?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no competing interests to declare. They have no personal or financial relationships with any individuals or organizations that could have influenced, or be perceived to have influenced, the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, identifiable private information, or animal subjects. It relies entirely on secondary analysis of de-identified, publicly available data from the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services State Drug Utilization Data. Ethics approval and informed consent were therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This study is an observational analysis of secondary data and did not involve a clinical trial.

detail.abstract: Brands shape what consumers choose, how they evaluate products, and their willingness to pay. We investigate whether brand equity can also shape patients' perceptions of drug safety. We do so by exploiting a large branding shock to a major pharmaceutical firm. The setting is the early, uncertain lockdown months of the COVID-19 pandemic. In November 2020, Pfizer announced Phase 3 efficacy results for its experimental COVID-19 vaccine. These results far exceeded expectations, triggering favorable coverage and a lasting reputational rise. We estimate its effect on perceived drug safety using the FDA's Adverse Event Reporting System, comparing Pfizer non-vaccine drugs against control counterparts. We find a 15% relative decline in the volume of adverse event (AE) reports for Pfizer's drugs. The decline concentrates where brand-driven perception has most room to operate: it appears only for patient-administered drugs (as opposed to clinician-administered); it is twice as large for ambiguous, non-serious events as for serious ones; and it is largest for hard-to-verify AEs, weakening monotonically as verifiability increases. Together, these patterns point to consumer perception as the primary channel. Overall, our findings indicate that firm-level reputational shocks can alter drugs' public safety record, with implications for brand management and pharmacovigilance.

AI.tldr: 本文利用辉瑞在2020年11月宣布新冠疫苗三期临床试验成功这一品牌声誉冲击，研究发现该事件导致辉瑞非疫苗药物的不良事件报告数量相对下降了15%，且该效应主要集中在患者自行用药、非严重事件和难以验证的不良事件中，表明品牌声誉能够改变消费者对药物安全性的感知。
AI.research_question: 品牌权益（brand equity）能否影响患者对药物安全性的感知？
AI.motivation: 品牌塑造消费者选择、产品评价和支付意愿已被广泛研究，但品牌权益是否会影响患者对药物安全性的感知尚不清楚。作者利用辉瑞新冠疫苗成功的巨大品牌声誉冲击来探究这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 品牌权益理论（brand equity）、消费者感知理论（consumer perception）、药物安全信号与报告偏差理论
AI.method: 利用FDA不良事件报告系统（FAERS）数据，采用双重差分法（DID），比较辉瑞非疫苗药物与对照药物的不良事件报告数量在辉瑞疫苗三期结果公布前后的变化差异。
AI.findings: （1）辉瑞非疫苗药物的不良事件报告数量相对下降了15%；（2）该效应仅发生在患者自行给药的药物中，而非临床医生给药的药物中；（3）效应在模糊的、非严重的不良事件中是严重事件的两倍；（4）效应在难以验证的不良事件中最大，并随可验证性增强而单调递减。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将品牌权益研究拓展到药物安全感知领域，揭示了企业层面的声誉冲击能够改变药物的公共安全记录，证实了消费者感知是主要传导渠道。
AI.practical_contributions: 对品牌管理（企业声誉的溢出效应）和药物警戒（ pharmacovigilance）实践具有重要启示，提示监管机构需关注品牌声誉对药物安全信号报告的可能干扰。

title: Geographical Indications and Pesticide Intensity: Evidence from the Italian Viticulture Sector
affiliations: University of Calabria,  and University of Calabria

detail.title: Geographical Indications and Pesticide Intensity: Evidence from the Italian Viticulture Sector

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: Geographical Indications (GIs) signal product quality and territorial reputation, yet their relationship with environmental sustainability remains unclear. This study investigates the link between GI certification, pesticide intensity, and environmental efficiency in Italian viticulture using farm-level data, a dynamic panel model, and a stochastic frontier approach. Results show that GI-certified farms use pesticides more intensively and display lower environmental efficiency. These findings suggest that stricter production standards aimed at ensuring grape quality may increase reliance on pesticides. The study highlights a potential trade-off between quality certification and environmental sustainability, with implications for EU agri-food and pesticide reduction policies.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用意大利葡萄种植的农场数据，发现地理标志认证的农场使用农药强度更高、环境效率更低，揭示了质量认证与环境保护之间的潜在权衡。
AI.research_question: 地理标志认证与农业环境可持续性（农药强度和环境效率）之间有何关系？
AI.motivation: 地理标志作为信号产品质量和地域声誉的制度，但其对环境可持续性的影响尚不明确，已有研究缺乏一致的结论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地理标志理论；环境效率理论；质量认证与投入品使用的权衡理论。
AI.method: 使用意大利农场层面的微观数据，采用动态面板模型分析农药强度，并运用随机前沿方法估计环境效率。
AI.findings: 地理标志认证的农场农药使用强度更高；地理标志认证的农场环境效率更低；严格的质量生产标准可能增加对农药的依赖。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了地理标志认证与农业环境可持续性之间的负向关系，为质量认证与环境保护之间的权衡提供了理论和实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟农产品政策及农药减量政策提供了启示：在推广地理标志等质量认证时，需考虑其可能带来的环境代价，并制定配套的可持续生产激励措施。

title: TCCC-ASM in the Russo-Ukrainian War: First Combat Experience as a Factor in the Gap Between Training and Practical Application of Knowledge and Skills Among Mobilized Military Personnel
affiliations: and Neurological and Neurosurgical Rehabilitation Research Centre "NODUS"

detail.title: TCCC-ASM in the Russo-Ukrainian War: First Combat Experience as a Factor in the Gap Between Training and Practical Application of Knowledge and Skills Among Mobilized Military Personnel

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest. The study was conducted independently. All materials used in this research were utilized exclusively for scientific purposes. The findings and conclusions presented herein reflect solely the views of the authors and do not represent the official position of any governmental, military, or non-governmental organization.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study was conducted in accordance with the ethical principles of the Declaration of Helsinki (2013 revision) and applicable national regulations governing biomedical research, personal data protection, and the handling of sensitive operational information in Ukraine. The study was based exclusively on de-identified and aggregated observational data obtained during routine educational, medical, and medical-evacuation activities conducted by the CIMMIC Non-Governmental Organization in cooperation with the Armed Forces of Ukraine. No experimental interventions were performed, no identifiable personal data were collected, and all information was analyzed in a fully anonymized form. To ensure operational security (OPSEC), no information capable of identifying military units, operational locations, evacuation routes, operational procedures, or individual participants was collected, stored, or analyzed. The study involved secondary analysis of dеobservational data generated during routine activities and did not influence the medical care, training process, or operational activities of the participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific funding from governmental, commercial, or non-governmental organizations. All stages of the study, including study design, data collection, data analysis, manuscript preparation, and the decision to submit the manuscript for publication, were performed independently by the authors within the framework of their professional activities and the educational mission of the non-profit, non-governmental organization “CIMMIC” (Ukraine).

detail.abstract:
Background: Tactical Combat Casualty Care for All Service Members (TCCC-ASM) aims to prepare military personnel to provide self-aid and buddy aid in combat. However, the extent to which acquired competencies are retained and translated into effective action during real combat remains poorly understood. This study evaluated the influence of first combat experience on the practical application of TCCC-ASM among mobilized military personnel during the Russo-Ukrainian War. 

Methods: A multicohort observational study with a mixed retrospective-prospective design was conducted between August 2022 and May 2026. Data from five independent cohorts were integrated, including educational assessments, structured surveys, operational observations, prehospital medical documentation, medical evacuation records, and rehabilitation data. The primary endpoint was the actual implementation of TCCC-ASM knowledge and skills during first combat experience. Transfer of training into operational practice was quantified using the authors' Training-to-Performance Index (TP-index). 

Results: A total of 1,961 participants were included. Although all participants successfully completed TCCC-ASM training, only 539 of 1,082 service members with combat experience (49.8%) subsequently encountered situations requiring the practical application of TCCC-ASM knowledge and skills. Among 327 wounded personnel, self-aid was performed by 71 individuals (21.7%), whereas 78.3% required buddy aid. The TP-index for self-aid was 0.132 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.104-0.163), indicating a substantial gap between successful training completion and performance under real combat conditions. Major barriers included severe pain, inability to recall procedures, panic reactions, limited visibility, and delayed evacuation. First combat experience was also associated with reassessment of the practical relevance of training and a unanimous demand for refresher training. A preprint-June 27, 2026 

Conclusions: A measurable gap exists between successful completion of TCCC-ASM training and the practical implementation of acquired competencies during combat. This phenomenon, defined as the Training-to-Performance Gap, highlights the limitations of relying solely on educational outcomes when evaluating military medical training. The proposed TP-index provides a quantitative framework for assessing the transfer of training into operational performance and supports the implementation of structured refresher training following first combat experience.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过俄乌战争期间的多队列观察，发现军事人员在成功完成战术战伤救治（TCCC-ASM）训练后，首次实战中知识技能的应用率仅为49.8%，自救TP指数仅0.132，揭示了显著的"训练-表现差距"，并提出了量化评估框架。
AI.research_question: 首次战斗经历对军事人员在实战中应用TCCC-ASM训练知识与技能的影响程度如何？
AI.motivation: TCCC-ASM训练旨在提升军人自救互救能力，但训练获得的能力在实战中能否有效转化尚不明确，现有研究缺乏对这一转化过程的量化评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 训练迁移理论（Transfer of Training）；训练-表现差距理论（Training-to-Performance Gap）
AI.method: 多队列混合回顾-前瞻性观察研究，整合五组独立队列数据（教育评估、结构化调查、作战观察、院前医疗文档、医疗后送记录、康复数据），使用作者自行开发的训练-表现指数（TP-index）进行量化评估。
AI.findings: 1）1961名参与者均完成训练，但仅49.8%有实战经历者在实战中遇到需要使用TCCC-ASM技能的情境；2）327名伤员中仅21.7%实施了自救，78.3%需要同伴救助；3）自救TP指数仅为0.132（95%CI: 0.104-0.163）；4）主要障碍包括剧痛、无法回忆操作步骤、恐慌反应、能见度受限和延迟后送；5）首次实战经验促使全体参与者要求复训。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出并定义了"训练-表现差距"（Training-to-Performance Gap）这一概念，并开发了TP-index作为量化评估训练向实战转化程度的工具，弥补了单纯以教育结果评估军事医疗训练的局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了现有TCCC-ASM训练在实战转化中的严重不足，为军事医疗训练体系改革提供实证依据；支持在首次实战后实施结构化复训，以缩小训练与实战表现之间的差距。

title: Queen Bee Reproductive Personalization: How Delegation Failure, Black-Boxed Knowledge, and Symbolic Nesting Undermine Succession Development
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Queen Bee Reproductive Personalization: How Delegation Failure, Black-Boxed Knowledge, and Symbolic Nesting Undermine Succession Development
detail.abstract:
This paper reconceptualizes personalization in organizations not merely as the concentration of task knowledge or authority, but as the concentration of an organization’s reproductive functions in a symbolically central individual. In this paper, reproduction does not refer to biological reproduction. Rather, it refers to the organizational process through which skills, judgment criteria, responsibility, evaluative standards, and workplace culture are transmitted to future members. While personalization has often been discussed as a problem of insufficient documentation, poor handover, or operational continuity risk, this paper focuses on a deeper problem: the condition in which not only current work, but also the capacity to develop successors, becomes dependent on a single person.

This paper calls this structure Queen Bee Reproductive Personalization. In eusocial insects, the concentration of reproductive function in the queen operates as an adaptive division of labor for colony survival. In human organizations, however, the concentration of succession development, knowledge transfer, delegation, responsibility transfer, evaluative judgment, and cultural continuity in one symbolically central individual may become organizationally pathological. Human organizations do not survive because one individual continues to “produce the future”; they survive because knowledge, judgment, responsibility, and culture are distributed, shared, questioned, and renewed across members.

The paper argues that Queen Bee Reproductive Personalization develops through a self-reinforcing process involving competence, responsibility, symbolic capital, delegation failure, micromanagement, reduced psychological safety, organizational silence, and the black-boxing of knowledge. A competent and responsible central figure may initially support the organization. However, when that person’s competence is not transformed into shared knowledge, transferable responsibility, the development of successors, and a renewable culture, the organization becomes increasingly dependent on that individual. As subordinates lose opportunities to judge, fail, ask questions, and assume responsibility, they may become workers who follow instructions rather than successors who can reproduce the organization’s knowledge and judgment.
The paper further argues that personalization appears not only in knowledge and decision-making, but also in workplace space. When a particular person’s objects, awards, dedicated tools, visual traces, spatial arrangements, and work routines accumulate in a shared workplace, the space itself may become a symbolic nest that preserves that person’s memory and authority. This paper calls this process Symbolic Nesting. It also introduces the concept of the Residual Queen Effect, referring to the persistence of a queen bee-type individual’s influence through objects, spatial arrangements, organizational memory, silence, and routines even after that person is no longer physically central to the workplace.

This paper extends the prior Queen Bee Structure framework. Whereas the previous Queen Bee Structure paper examined how an established queen bee structure becomes culturally reproduced through Worker Bee Zombies, this paper moves one step backward and asks how such a structure emerges in the first place. It examines why a workplace becomes unable to reproduce knowledge, judgment, responsibility, and culture without a queen bee-type individual. The paper also connects this framework to Structural Selection Pressure, Silent Harassment, and Ma-Meme. Ma-Meme, an abbreviation of Multiple Anger Meme, is treated here as a secondary framework for understanding how anger-based behaviors may later become culturally reproduced through psychological reward, organizational justification, and social imitation.

The central claim of this paper is that the real danger for organizations is not the presence of a strong individual. The danger emerges when that strength does not produce successors. Queen Bee Reproductive Personalization describes a structure in which an organization appears to be supported by competence, while failing to become competent itself.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"蜂后生殖性个人化"概念，指组织的知识、判断、责任和文化延续能力集中于单一象征性中心个体的病态结构，而非简单的工作知识或权力集中。文章指出，组织的真正危险不在于存在强大个体，而在于这种强大未能培养出继任者。
AI.research_question: 组织中的个人化现象如何从一种看似高效的劳动分工演变为组织病理结构？尤其是，当一个组织的知识、判断、责任和文化再生产功能集中于单一个体时，这种结构是如何产生并自我强化的？
AI.motivation: 现有文献通常将个人化视为文档不足、交接不善或运营连续性风险等表面问题，而本文试图揭示更深层的问题：不仅是当前工作依赖个人，连培养继任者的能力也依赖于同一个人。这种结构使组织看似被能力支撑，却无法自身变得有能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 蜂后生殖性个人化（Queen Bee Reproductive Personalization）；象征性筑巢（Symbolic Nesting）；残余蜂后效应（Residual Queen Effect）；蜂后结构框架；结构性选择压力；沉默骚扰；马米姆（Ma-Meme，多重愤怒迷因）
AI.method: 理论概念化与框架构建，基于对既有蜂后结构理论的延伸和批判性分析，通过逻辑推理和概念演绎建立理论模型。
AI.findings: 1. 蜂后生殖性个人化通过能力、责任、象征资本、授权失败、微观管理、心理安全感降低、组织沉默和知识黑箱化等自我强化过程形成。2. 个人化不仅体现在知识和决策中，还体现在工作空间（象征性筑巢）。3. 残余蜂后效应指即使蜂后式个体不再处于物理中心，其影响仍通过物品、空间安排、组织记忆、沉默和惯例持续存在。4. 与先前蜂后结构论文关注结构如何被文化再生产不同，本文关注结构如何最初产生。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将个人化概念从知识/权力集中重新定义为组织生殖功能集中，提供了新的理论视角。2. 提出"蜂后生殖性个人化"概念，区分了真社会性昆虫的适应性分工与人类组织的病态结构。3. 提出"象征性筑巢"和"残余蜂后效应"两个新概念，拓展了个人化的空间维度。4. 将分析从"结构如何被再生产"前移至"结构如何产生"，完善了蜂后结构理论的演化逻辑。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提醒组织管理者：真正的风险不在于存在强势个体，而在于这种强势未能转化为可传承的组织能力。2. 指出组织应关注下属是否从"执行指令的工人"蜕变为"能再生产组织知识和判断的继任者"。3. 揭示工作空间中的象征性物品和空间安排可能成为个人化持续存在的隐性机制。4. 帮助组织识别"残余蜂后效应"，即在关键人物离开后，其隐性影响仍可能制约组织的知识传承和文化更新。

reference: INSEAD Working Paper No. 2026/41/STR
title: The Learning Power of Firms: A New Dimension of Competitive Advantage in the Age of AI
affiliations: Cornell University and INSEAD - Strategy

detail.title: The Learning Power of Firms: A New Dimension of Competitive Advantage in the Age of AI

publicationDetails.journalName: INSEAD Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: The organizational learning literature has long recognized the strategic value of learning, but has conceptualized it primarily as a human-centered, episodic, and reflective capability. The proliferation of artificial intelligence fundamentally alters these assumptions: learning is increasingly embedded in operational systems, continuous in tempo, and distributed across the full surface of organizational activity rather than concentrated in designated learning units. This paper introduces the concept of learning power-a composite organizational capability constituted by four interdependent dimensions: learning density (the proportion of organizational interactions that generate usable insight), learning velocity (the speed with which insight is translated into changed system behavior), learning scale (the number of simultaneous learning processes the organization can sustain), and learning directionality (the alignment of learning objectives with strategic intent and organizational values). We propose that competitive advantage in AI-enabled environments is increasingly determined by the multiplicative combination of these four dimensions-Learning Power = Density × Velocity × Scale × Directionalityrather than by any single component. We further distinguish the concept of the learning surface-the distributed organizational architecture through which AI-enabled learning operates-from the learning units and episodic learning processes that characterize conventional accounts. The paper situates the learning power framework within the context of companion contributions on AI competitive architecture (Dutta & Doz, INSEAD Working Paper, 2026/38/STR), programmable strategy (Doz & Dutta, INSEAD Working Paper, 2026/39/STR), and strategic envelope governance (Dutta & Doz, INSEAD Working Paper, 2026/40/STR), and draws out implications for organizational learning theory, dynamic capabilities, and the human governance of machine learning systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"学习动力"（Learning Power）这一复合组织能力概念，认为在人工智能日益普及的环境中，竞争优势取决于学习密度、学习速度、学习规模和学习方向性四个维度的乘积组合，而非单一维度。文章将学习从传统的人力中心、 episodic（间断性）和反思性能力，重新概念化为嵌入运营系统、持续进行、分布在整个组织活动表面的能力。
AI.research_question: 在人工智能深度嵌入组织运营的背景下，组织的学习能力如何被重新概念化？什么样的复合组织能力决定AI赋能环境下的竞争优势？
AI.motivation: 传统组织学习文献将学习视为以人为中心、间歇性和反思性的能力，而人工智能的普及从根本上改变了这些假设——学习日益嵌入运营系统、节奏持续化、分布在组织活动的整个表面而非集中在指定的学习单元。现有理论框架无法解释这一转变，亟需新的概念化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 学习动力框架（Learning Power = Density × Velocity × Scale × Directionality），以及"学习表面"（learning surface）概念——AI赋能学习所依托的分布式组织架构，区别于传统学习单元和间断性学习过程。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性论文（INSEAD工作论文系列），通过理论建构提出框架。
AI.findings: 学习动力是一个由四个相互依赖的维度构成的复合组织能力：学习密度（产生可用洞见的组织互动比例）、学习速度（洞见转化为系统行为变化的速度）、学习规模（组织能同时维持的学习过程数量）、学习方向性（学习目标与战略意图和组织价值观的一致性）。竞争优势取决于四个维度的乘积组合，而非单一维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 重新概念化了组织学习——从人力中心、间断性、反思性能力转向嵌入系统、持续、分布式的能力；2. 提出了"学习动力"和"学习表面"概念，丰富了组织学习理论和动态能力理论；3. 将学习与AI战略架构、可编程战略、战略包络治理等概念联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织在AI时代设计和管理学习系统提供了概念框架——管理者需同时关注学习的密度、速度、规模和方向性，并意识到四者的乘积效应；同时指出了人类对机器学习系统进行治理的必要性。

title: The Softmax of Default: Exact Pricing and Analytic Risk Attribution for First-to-Default Basket Swaps with Heterogeneous Recoveries
affiliations: ZHAW School of Management and Law

detail.title: The Softmax of Default: Exact Pricing and Analytic Risk Attribution for First-to-Default Basket Swaps with Heterogeneous Recoveries
detail.abstract: First-to-default (FtD) basket swaps pay the loss of whichever name defaults first. With heterogeneous recoveries the payo! depends on the first defaulter's identity, so name-level allocation and stable Greeks are typically delegated to generic basket engines. This letter shows that under a common-baseline separable-exponential survival structure, the first-defaulter identity is exactly independent of the first-default time, with deterministic Boltzmann-Gibbs (softmax) weights. The identity calculus extends beyond independence: exact separation persists, with the same weights, under common multiplicative frailty, and survives with shock-driven weights under Marshall-Olkin common shocks once a tie rule is specified. Under copula dependence the constant softmax generally becomes time-varying, while pricing remains one-dimensional. The FtD protection value then factorizes into a severity term (the expected LGD of the first defaulter) and a timing term (the value of a unit first-default claim), delivering simulation-free pricing, deterministic name-level attribution, and analytic Greeks under standard CDS conventions. A public-data illustration supplies a diagnostic for the common-baseline restriction and checks the analytic spread against Monte Carlo under the same calibrated model; for the studied basket, the fit is tight across calm and stress regimes. Further extensions (heterogeneous baselines, piecewiseexact tenor-grid calibration, and stochastic recoveries) and detailed proofs are in an Online Appendix.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，在共同基线可分离指数生存结构下，首次违约者的身份与首次违约时间独立，具有确定的玻尔兹曼-吉布斯（softmax）权重。这一性质在多因素脆弱性、马歇尔-奥尔金共同冲击下依然成立，使得首次违约篮子的定价、名称级归属和希腊字母均可解析计算，无需蒙特卡洛模拟。
AI.research_question: 在首次违约篮子互换（FtD）定价中，能否在不依赖通用篮子引擎的情况下，实现名称级分配、稳定希腊字母和免模拟定价？
AI.motivation: 首次违约篮子互换的支付取决于最先违约者的身份，而异质回收率使得定价和希腊字母计算通常依赖模拟。本文试图寻找一种解析结构，使首次违约者身份与违约时间分离，从而实现高效定价与风险管理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 共同基线可分离指数生存结构；玻尔兹曼-吉布斯（softmax）权重；多因素脆弱性；马歇尔-奥尔金共同冲击；Copula相依性。
AI.method: 理论推导：证明在特定生存结构下首次违约者身份与时间的独立性；数值验证：使用公开数据校准模型，并将解析价差与蒙特卡洛模拟结果进行对比。
AI.findings: 1. 共同基线可分离指数生存结构下，首次违约者身份与违约时间独立，权重为确定性softmax。2. 该性质在共同乘法脆弱性和马歇尔-奥尔金冲击下仍然保持（后者需指定平局规则）。3. Copula相依下softmax权重随时间变化，但定价仍为一维积分。4. FtD保护价值可分解为严重性项（预期LGD）和时间项（单位首次违约索赔价值），实现免模拟定价、确定性名称级归属和解析希腊字母。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次严格证明了共同基线可分离指数生存结构下首次违约者身份与违约时间的独立性；将该性质推广至脆弱性和共同冲击模型；建立了FtD保护价值因式分解的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出免模拟的FtD定价方法，实现确定性名称级风险归因和解析希腊字母，大幅降低计算成本。公开数据校准表明模型在平静和压力市场下均拟合良好。

title: From AI Literacy to AI Fluency: A Developmental Framework for Higher Education
affiliations: Coastline Community College

detail.title: From AI Literacy to AI Fluency: A Developmental Framework for Higher Education

declarations.ethicsApproval: There were no human subjects included in this study

detail.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence has moved rapidly into teaching, learning, research, and administrative work, yet the dominant institutional response has centered on AI literacy alone. This conceptual article argues that AI literacy, defined as understanding basic concepts, recognizing tools, performing basic tasks, and identifying broad risks such as bias, hallucination, privacy harm, and misinformation, is necessary but insufficient for higher education in the generative era. The article advances a developmental AI Fluency framework that extends literacy toward strategic, critical, ethical, and contextual use of artificial intelligence while preserving human judgment, authorship, accountability, and disciplinary standards. The framework specifies six developmental levels, from AI Exposure and AI Awareness through Functional and Critical AI Literacy and on to Disciplinary AI Fluency, Generative AI Fluency, and Responsible AI Leadership, with the lower tiers forming a literacy band and the higher tiers forming a fluency band. It pairs these levels with six competency domains spanning conceptual understanding, operational skill, epistemic verification, ethical and legal judgment, metacognitive and human agency, and disciplinary transfer. A central claim is that fluency is a socio-technical capacity rather than an individual skill alone, depending on curriculum design, assessment redesign, faculty development, equitable access, policy, data governance, and human-centered principles. The article concludes that institutions should treat AI fluency as a core learning outcome and offers implications for practice and a research agenda.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI素养（AI Literacy）不足以应对生成式AI时代的高等教育挑战，进而构建了一个从素养到流畅度的六层次发展框架，强调AI流畅度（AI Fluency）是一种社会技术能力，应成为高校核心学习成果。
AI.research_question: 在生成式AI时代，高等教育仅靠AI素养是否足够？一个更全面的AI流畅度框架应如何构建？
AI.motivation: 当前高校对生成式AI的主流回应仅停留在AI素养层面，缺乏对战略性、批判性、伦理性和情境性使用AI的系统框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 发展性AI流畅度框架（Developmental AI Fluency Framework），包含六个发展层级（AI接触、AI意识、功能性AI素养、批判性AI素养、学科AI流畅度、生成式AI流畅度、负责任的AI领导力）和六大能力领域（概念理解、操作技能、认知验证、伦理与法律判断、元认知与人类能动性、学科迁移）。
AI.method: 概念性文章（Conceptual Article），通过理论构建和逻辑论证提出框架。
AI.findings: AI素养（理解基本概念、识别工具、执行基本任务、识别偏见/幻觉/隐私/错误信息等风险）是必要但不充分的；AI流畅度是一种社会技术能力，依赖于课程设计、评估改革、教师发展、公平准入、政策、数据治理和以人为本的原则；建议将AI流畅度作为核心学习成果。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统区分了AI素养与AI流畅度的概念边界；提出了多层级的AI发展框架，将技术能力与社会、伦理、学科情境整合；强调流畅度是"社会技术能力"而非单一个人技能。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高校提供了从课程设计、评估改革、教师发展到数据治理的实践指导；建议将AI流畅度纳入核心学习成果体系；提出了未来研究方向。

title: The AI Memetic Orchestration Framework: Toward Governed, Reusable, and Auditable Multi-Agent AI Architectures
affiliations: Coastline Community College

detail.title: The AI Memetic Orchestration Framework: Toward Governed, Reusable, and Auditable Multi-Agent AI Architectures

declarations.ethicsApproval: There were no human subjects included in this study.

detail.abstract: The shift from prompt engineering to agentic, multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems has moved the locus of value from the design of individual instructions to the coordination of systems in which models plan, invoke tools, retrieve context, and collaborate across specialized roles (Wang et al., 2024; Xi et al., 2023; Guo et al., 2024). This transition introduces a class of goal-directed, partially autonomous systems whose growing capability is accompanied by hallucination and reliability concerns (Zhao et al., 2026), adversarial exposure through tool access (OWASP Foundation, 2025), and coordination-driven scaling complexity (Guo et al., 2024). The paper argue that prompt engineering alone is insufficient for these conditions: optimizing a single instruction does not determine how tasks are routed and sequenced, how tool access is bounded, how outputs are validated, or how institutions remain accountable for autonomous action problems that are inherently socio-technical (National Institute of Standards and Technology, 2023). This article's contribution is the AI Memetic Orchestration Framework (AMOF), a proposed six-layer conceptual model comprising Memetic, Boundary, Framework, Orchestration, Evaluation, and Governance layers, that integrates currently fragmented work on agent design patterns (Anthropic, 2024), guardrails and oversight (OpenAI, 2025; Verdiesen et al., 2020; Sterz et al., 2024), and risk-management standards (National Institute of Standards and Technology, 2023; Microsoft Corporation, 2022) into a coherent scaffold for designing and governing orchestrated LLM systems. The paper position AMOF beyond prompt engineering, context engineering, workflow automation, and software architecture; introduce AI memetics, boundary prompting, and framework engineering as explicitly proposed rather than established constructs; and frame the responsible operation of agentic AI as the deliberate, layered orchestration of memetic, bounded, frameworkdriven, evaluated, and governed components that balance autonomous capability against bounded human oversight.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI模因编排框架（AMOF），一个六层概念模型，用于设计和治理由大语言模型驱动的智能体系统，超越了传统提示工程，将代理设计模式、防护栏、风险管理标准整合为一个连贯的编排架构。
AI.research_question: 如何从概念层面设计和治理多智能体大语言模型系统，以应对幻觉、对抗性攻击、协调复杂性等可靠性问题，并确保机构问责？
AI.motivation: 从提示工程到智能体系统的范式转变带来了新的可靠性、安全性和治理挑战，而单一的提示优化无法解决任务路由、工具访问边界、输出验证和机构问责等社会技术问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI模因编排框架（AMOF），包含六个层：模因层（Memetic）、边界层（Boundary）、框架层（Framework）、编排层（Orchestration）、评估层（Evaluation）和治理层（Governance）。引入了AI模因学、边界提示和框架工程作为新构念。
AI.method: 概念性框架构建，整合现有文献中代理设计模式、防护栏与监督、风险管理标准等分散工作。
AI.findings: 提示工程不足以应对智能体系统的复杂性；AMOF提供了一个超越提示工程、上下文工程、工作流自动化和软件架构的连贯编排框架；负责任地运行代理AI需要层叠式的模因、边界、框架驱动、评估和治理组件的协调。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AMOF六层概念模型，将AI模因学、边界提示和框架工程作为新构念引入，整合了分散的代理设计、安全监督和风险管理文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计和治理多智能体LLM系统提供了结构化概念框架，帮助从业者在自主能力和人工监督之间取得平衡，提升系统可靠性、安全性和机构问责性。

title: Conflict-Penalized Decision Selection: A Behavioral Model of Internal Conflict and Organizational Decision-Making

detail.title: Conflict-Penalized Decision Selection: A Behavioral Model of Internal Conflict and Organizational Decision-Making

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. The research was conducted independently and without any personal or financial relationships that could be perceived to influence the results or interpretation of the study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, patient data, or experimental subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
This paper develops a formal theoretical model of decision-making under internal conflict, conceptualized as conflict-penalized selection among heterogeneous behavioral and organizational layers. Unlike preference-based, dual-process, or bounded rationality approaches, the model treats inconsistency not as preference instability or cognitive error, but as the outcome of time-varying dominance among distinct functional components: Identification (authorship and feasibility), Relational and Institutional Constraint (social and governance pressures), Influence Persistence (habit and routine dynamics), and Justificatory Constraint (beliefs and permissibility conditions).

The model is structured as a two-stage process separating internal selection from external expression, where selection determines the chosen action through a conflict-penalized score and expression governs how that action becomes observable through timing, communication, and implementation conditions. This separation allows coherent internal decisions to be analytically distinguished from failures in signaling, rollout, or reception.

The paper introduces Lifestyle Coherence as a trajectory-level construct evaluating whether repeated sequences of selection, expression, and feedback preserve authorship, structural alignment, and conflict absorption over time. The framework generates testable implications for phenomena such as procrastination, compliance without agreement, preference reversals, organizational rollout failure, and performative agreement.

By integrating layered conflict mechanisms, expressive transformation, and dynamic feedback into a unified formulation, the model provides a diagnostic alternative to standard decision-theoretic accounts and offers a basis for empirical analysis of behavioral and organizational inconsistency across repeated decision cycles.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个形式化的理论模型，将决策中的内部冲突概念化为不同行为与组织层之间的冲突惩罚选择，区别于偏好、双过程或有限理性模型，强调不一致性源于随时间变化的功能组件主导权的交替。
AI.research_question: 如何形式化建模决策中的内部冲突，以解释行为和组织层面的不一致现象？
AI.motivation: 现有决策理论（偏好基础、双过程、有限理性）无法充分解释决策中的系统性不一致现象，如拖延、合规但不认同、偏好反转、组织执行失败和表演性同意。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内部冲突作为冲突惩罚选择的理论框架，包括四个功能组件：认同（作者身份与可行性）、关系与制度约束（社会与治理压力）、影响持久性（习惯与常规动力）、正当性约束（信念与允许条件）
AI.method: 形式化理论建模，构建两阶段决策过程：内部选择（冲突惩罚评分决定行动选择）与外部表达（行动通过时机、沟通、实施条件变得可观察）
AI.findings: 提出了生活方式一致性作为轨迹层面构念，评估重复的选择-表达-反馈序列是否随时间保持作者身份、结构对齐与冲突吸收；模型对拖延、合规但不认同、偏好反转、组织执行失败、表演性同意等现象产生可检验的命题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将不一致性内生化，而非归因于偏好不稳定或认知错误；2. 建立内部选择与外部表达的区分，使连贯的内部决策与信号/实施/接收失败可在分析上分离；3. 引入生活方式一致性作为动态反馈的跨周期评估指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为诊断行为与组织不一致性提供新的分析工具，适用于理解拖延症、组织变革中的变相抵制、策略执行失败等现实现象。

title: Governance Concentration in Decentralized Finance: A Comparative Analysis of MakerDAO, Lido, and Ethereum Name Service Using the Zero Point Senemosìa Framework

detail.title: Governance Concentration in Decentralized Finance: A Comparative Analysis of MakerDAO, Lido, and Ethereum Name Service Using the Zero Point Senemosìa Framework
detail.abstract: Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs) promise democratic governance through token-weighted voting, yet empirical evidence reveals extreme concentration of voting power comparable to the world's most unequal countries. This paper introduces the Zero Point Senemosìa (ZPS) framework, a novel approach to quantifying governance health in DAOs through quantum-inspired organizational modeling. We analyze three major DAOs-MakerDAO (MKR), Lido (LDO), and Ethereum Name Service (ENS)-revealing distinct governance pathologies: MKR exhibits polarized debate (DHI = 0.68), LDO demonstrates silent consensus masking concentration (DHI = 0.71), and ENS presents acute treasury capture risk despite high participation (DHI = 0.59). Our analysis reveals Gini coefficients ranging from 0.80-0.89 and Nakamoto coefficients as low as 4, indicating that merely 4-7 entities control 51% of governance in these protocols worth $14B+ in total value locked. We introduce the DAO Health Index (DHI) as a quantitative governance metric and propose the Protocol for Auto-corrective Reconfiguration and Equilibrium (PARE) as a framework for designing self-correcting governance mechanisms. Our findings have direct implications for regulatory policy, institutional investment, and the design of future decentralized systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ZPS框架，通过量子启发的组织建模量化DAO治理健康，分析三大DAO发现极端权力集中（基尼系数0.80-0.89，中本系数低至4），引入DAO健康指数（DHI）和PARE自校正治理机制框架。
AI.research_question: 如何量化评估DAO的治理健康状况？DAO的治理权力集中程度及其表现形式是什么？
AI.motivation: DAO号称通过代币加权投票实现民主治理，但实证显示投票权极端集中，现有缺乏系统的量化评估框架来诊断DAO治理病理。
AI.theoretical_framework: ZPS（Zero Point Senemosìa）框架——量子启发的组织建模；DAO健康指数（DHI）；基尼系数与中本系数。
AI.method: 对MakerDAO、Lido、ENS三大DAO进行实证分析，计算DHI、基尼系数和中本系数等量化指标。
AI.findings: 三大DAO治理病理各异：MKR极化辩论（DHI=0.68），LDO沉默共识掩盖集中（DHI=0.71），ENS高参与度下存在国库被捕获风险（DHI=0.59）；基尼系数0.80-0.89，中本系数低至4，即4-7个实体控制51%治理权。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出ZPS框架将量子模型引入组织治理分析；首次系统量化DAO的"民主悖论"；建立DHI综合评估指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出PARE自校正治理机制框架；为监管政策制定、机构投资决策和去中心化系统设计提供直接指导。

title: Unequal Access to Urban Green Space: Evidence from NYC Parks
affiliations: HKU Business School,  and California State University, Fullerton

detail.title: Unequal Access to Urban Green Space: Evidence from NYC Parks

publicationDetails.detailsText: HKU Jockey Club Enterprise Sustainability Global Research Institute Paper No. 2026/154
publicationDetails.journalName: Hong Kong University Business School: HKU Jockey Club Enterprise Sustainability Global Research Institute Paper Series

detail.abstract: Urban parks are nominally public goods, yet access to green space is deeply unequal across neighborhoods. This paper constructs a novel Park Accessibility Index for all 2,167 census tracts in New York City that augments boundary-based park coverage with buffer-zone green space at 0.1 and 0.2 miles, reducing the fraction of tracts classified as entirely park-inaccessible from 50 to 21 percent. Using SafeGraph mobility data from 2018 to 2022, we exploit the COVID-19 pandemic as a quasi-natural experiment to estimate how park access mediates the behavioral and welfare consequences of a large mobility shock. In a matched difference-indifferences design, park-deprived tracts experienced approximately 47 fewer park visitors per month and a 7 percent decline in log visits relative to matched park-rich tracts. Applying the travel cost method, we estimate that park-deprived tracts lost 42.7 percent of their annual park consumer surplus post-COVID, compared to 30.2 percent for park-rich tracts-a 41 percent larger proportional welfare loss. The disparity is sharpest for low-income households within park-deprived communities, who lost over half their baseline park welfare. Our findings document a welfare externality of chronic park underfunding that standard fiscal analysis omits.

AI.tldr: 本文利用纽约市2167个人口普查区的数据，构建了新型公园可达性指数，并借助COVID-19作为准自然实验，研究发现公园匮乏的社区在疫情后比公园丰富的社区多损失41%的消费者福利，低收入家庭损失尤其严重。
AI.research_question: 公园可达性如何影响居民在面对重大流动性冲击（如COVID-19疫情）时的行为反应和福利变化？
AI.motivation: 城市公园名义上是公共品，但社区间的绿色空间获取存在严重不平等。现有财政分析忽视了长期公园投资不足造成的福利外部性，本文旨在量化这种不平等带来的福利损失。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于旅行成本法（Travel Cost Method）计算消费者剩余，利用COVID-19疫情作为准自然实验，结合匹配双重差分法（Matched Difference-in-Differences）识别因果效应。
AI.method: 构建新型Park Accessibility Index（结合边界覆盖率和0.1/0.2英里缓冲区）；使用SafeGraph 2018-2022年移动数据；匹配双重差分设计；旅行成本法估算消费者剩余变化。
AI.findings: 1. 新型指数将完全无法进入公园的普查区比例从50%降至21%。2. 公园匮乏区比丰富区每月少47次公园访问，访问量下降7%。3. 公园匮乏区消费者剩余下降42.7%，丰富区为30.2%，前者福利损失高出41%。4. 匮乏区低收入家庭损失超过基线福利的一半。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化了公园可达性不平等带来的"福利外部性"；将旅行成本法应用于准自然实验框架，识别了绿色空间获取差异的因果福利效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市公园投资决策提供了量化依据：公园资金不足不仅影响使用，更会产生显著的福利损失外部性；为政策制定者识别最需要公园投资的贫困社区提供了实证证据。

title: Hedges of the Digital Age: A VAR-GARCH Analysis of Gold, Cryptocurrency, and Geopolitical Leading Indicators (2016-2026)

detail.title: Hedges of the Digital Age: A VAR-GARCH Analysis of Gold, Cryptocurrency, and Geopolitical Leading Indicators (2016-2026)
detail.abstract: This study examines whether gold (GLD) and Bitcoin (BTC-USD) respond differently to geopolitical stress signals, using daily data spanning January 2016 to February 2026. Employing VAR-GARCH and IGARCH specifications alongside Granger causality tests and Chow structural break analysis, we investigate the safe-haven properties of both assets under geopolitical risk, with particular attention to U.S. tariff escalations between January 2025 and February 2026. A confirmed structural break on April 2, 2025 demarcates full-sample and sub-period analyses. Within the Liberation Day window, the iShares U.S. Aerospace and Defence ETF (ITA) Granger-precedes BTC-USD (p=0.013) and shows borderline predictive content for GLD (p=0.091), suggesting that defence equity markets transmit geopolitical stress signals to both assets. BTC-USD exhibits Integrated GARCH behaviour (α+β = 1.000), implying permanent volatility persistence, while GLD's α+β = 0.988 gives a volatility half-life of approximately 57 trading days, indicating mean reversion. During acute geopolitical stress, GLD functions as a safe haven while BTC-USD is abandoned, underscoring their structurally divergent roles in the global monetary system.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用2016年1月至2026年2月的日度数据，通过VAR-GARCH、IGARCH、Granger因果检验和Chow结构断点分析，考察黄金（GLD）和比特币（BTC-USD）对地缘政治压力信号的不同反应。研究发现，在2025年4月2日“解放日”关税升级等急性地缘政治压力时期，黄金发挥避险功能，而比特币被投资者抛售，二者在全球货币体系中角色结构迥异。
AI.research_question: 黄金和比特币在面对地缘政治压力信号时，是否表现出不同的避险属性？具体而言，在美国关税升级等急性地缘政治事件期间，二者的价格行为有何差异？
AI.motivation: 随着地缘政治风险加剧（尤其是美国关税政策变化）以及加密货币市场的扩张，投资者和政策制定者需要厘清传统避险资产（黄金）与新兴数字资产（比特币）在极端不确定性时期的真实表现差异，以优化资产配置和风险管理策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 避险资产理论（Safe-Haven Theory）；地缘政治风险传导机制；GARCH/IGARCH波动率建模理论；Granger因果关系及结构断点分析框架。
AI.method: 采用VAR-GARCH和IGARCH模型，结合Granger因果检验和Chow结构断点分析。使用GLD（黄金ETF）、BTC-USD（比特币）和ITA（iShares美国航空航天与国防ETF，作为地缘政治压力代理变量）的日度数据，覆盖2016年1月至2026年2月，并在2025年4月2日确认结构断点后进行全样本与子样本分段分析。
AI.findings: （1）2025年4月2日“解放日”存在显著结构断点；（2）在该窗口内，ITA Granger导致BTC-USD（p=0.013），并对GLD有边缘显著的预测力（p=0.091），说明国防板块传递地缘政治压力信号；（3）BTC-USD呈现积分GARCH行为（α+β=1.000），波动具有永久持续性；GLD的α+β=0.988，波动半衰期约57个交易日，存在均值回复；（4）急性地缘政治压力期间，黄金发挥避险功能，而比特币被抛售。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了黄金作为传统避险资产在地缘政治极端压力下的有效性，同时揭示了比特币不具备类似避险属性反而被抛售的特征，对数字资产是否具备“数字黄金”地位的理论争议提供了实证反驳。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者在地缘政治风险加剧时的资产配置提供依据：黄金仍可作为有效的避险工具，而比特币不适合作为地缘政治压力下的避险资产；为政策制定者理解加密货币市场在极端事件中的脆弱性提供参考。

detail.abstract:
Who gets counted determines who gets care. Public health funding and policy decisions rely on data systems that routinely underrepresent people experiencing homelessness, undocumented immigrants, non-English speakers, rural residents, and other underserved populations. At the same time, the termination of 444 Centers for Disease Control and Prevention grants totaling $5.78 billion has raised significant questions about the future of the nation’s public health infrastructure.

This policy brief examines the intersection of federal public health funding reductions, legal challenges, and structural data exclusion. Drawing on Congressional Research Service reports, federal court filings, agency documents, and peer-reviewed research, it distinguishes verified facts from policy analysis while assessing the consequences for health equity and community-based public health practice.

The paper also introduces the She Is Us United Community Data Framework, an operational model that uses Community Health Workers, trauma-informed engagement, and longitudinal data collection to reach populations often excluded from traditional surveillance. It argues that strengthening community-generated data can improve Community Health Needs Assessments, support evidence-based policymaking, and produce a more accurate understanding of health needs. The findings suggest that restoring public health infrastructure requires not only renewed investment but also new approaches to ensuring every community is counted.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨联邦公共卫生资金削减与结构性数据排除如何导致无家可归者、无证移民等弱势群体在公共卫生数据中被系统性遗漏，并提出"我们就是美国"社区数据框架作为解决方案。
AI.research_question: 联邦公共卫生资金削减与结构性数据排除如何影响健康公平？社区生成数据能否弥补传统监测系统的不足？
AI.motivation: 公共卫生资金和政策决策依赖的数据系统经常遗漏弱势群体，同时CDC 444项拨款终止引发对公共卫生基础设施未来的担忧，亟需审视数据排除与资金削减的交叉影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 健康公平理论、结构性数据排除、社区参与式研究、创伤知情实践
AI.method: 政策分析，综合国会研究服务报告、联邦法院文件、机构文件和同行评审研究
AI.findings: 恢复公共卫生基础设施不仅需要重新投资，还需要确保每个社区都被纳入统计的新方法；社区生成数据可改善社区健康需求评估并支持循证政策制定。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"我们就是美国"社区数据框架这一操作性模型，将社区健康工作者、创伤知情参与和纵向数据收集系统整合，为结构性数据排除问题提供理论解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和公共卫生从业者提供可操作的社区数据收集框架；指出资金削减对弱势群体的具体影响路径；为改进社区健康需求评估提供实证依据。

detail.title: Family Therapy for Adolescent Substance Use: Implementation Research Planning Procedures, Advances, and Horizons
detail.abstract: This article describes basic elements of implementation research planning for behavioral interventions and applies those elements to create a planning blueprint for research on family therapy (FT) for adolescent substance use. The blueprint is designed to guide researchers in conceptualizing FT implementation research and focuses on four procedures: FT service needs assessment, FT selection and modification, FT implementation strategy selection and modification, and FT implementation strategy mechanisms modeling. For each procedure, the article introduces key implementation science concepts and guidelines; highlights related advances in FT implementation research on adolescent substance use; names current priorities for further advancing this area; and nominates promising options for addressing those priorities. The ultimate goal is to spark innovation in FT implementation research in the service of promoting the adoption and sustainment of evidence-based FT services.

title: The Tumor Microenvironment in Cancer Progression, Metastasis, and Immunotherapy Response

detail.title: The Tumor Microenvironment in Cancer Progression, Metastasis, and Immunotherapy Response

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animals, or patient data. All data used in this research were obtained from publicly available datasets (BUSI - Breast Ultrasound Images Dataset). Therefore, no ethics approval was required.

detail.abstract: The tumor microenvironment (TME) is a dynamic and complex ecosystem composed of malignant cells and surrounding stromal, immune, vascular, and extracellular matrix components that collectively influence cancer development and therapeutic outcomes. Major constituents of the TME include cancer-associated fibroblasts, tumor-associated macrophages, lymphocytes, endothelial cells, cytokines, chemokines, and extracellular matrix proteins. Increasing evidence demonstrates that these cellular and non-cellular elements actively regulate tumor initiation, progression, and metastatic dissemination by promoting cancer cell proliferation, angiogenesis, invasion, and immune evasion. The TME also contributes significantly to therapeutic resistance by establishing immunosuppressive conditions that impair antitumor immune responses and reduce the efficacy of conventional therapies and immune checkpoint inhibitors. Interactions between tumor cells and the surrounding microenvironment facilitate the recruitment of suppressive immune cells, remodeling of the extracellular matrix, and secretion of protumorigenic mediators that support tumor survival and metastatic colonization. Recent advances in cancer biology have highlighted the therapeutic potential of targeting the TME through strategies such as immune checkpoint blockade, reprogramming of tumorassociated macrophages, inhibition of angiogenesis, and modulation of stromal signaling pathways. These approaches aim to transform the immunosuppressive microenvironment into one that supports effective antitumor immunity and enhances treatment responsiveness. A comprehensive understanding of the molecular and cellular mechanisms governing the TME offers new opportunities for precision oncology and the development of personalized therapeutic interventions that improve clinical outcomes and the effectiveness of cancer immunotherapy.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了肿瘤微环境（TME）的组成、功能及其在癌症发展、治疗抵抗和免疫治疗中的关键作用，并探讨了靶向TME的治疗策略。
AI.research_question: 肿瘤微环境如何影响癌症进展、治疗抵抗及免疫治疗疗效？靶向TME的潜在治疗策略有哪些？
AI.motivation: 肿瘤微环境在癌症发展中扮演关键角色，但对其复杂机制及治疗潜力的系统理解仍不充分，需要全面梳理以推动精准肿瘤学发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 肿瘤微环境生态学理论；免疫编辑理论；血管生成与基质重塑理论；免疫逃逸与治疗抵抗理论。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，系统梳理和整合现有关于TME组成、功能机制及靶向策略的研究证据。
AI.findings: (1) TME通过促进增殖、血管生成、侵袭和免疫逃逸调控肿瘤进展；(2) TME通过建立免疫抑制状态导致治疗抵抗；(3) 靶向TME策略包括免疫检查点阻断、巨噬细胞重编程、抗血管生成和基质信号调节等，有望改善免疫治疗疗效。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了TME在肿瘤发生、进展、转移及治疗抵抗中的多维度作用机制，为理解肿瘤-微环境互作提供了全面的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为开发靶向TME的精准肿瘤治疗策略提供了理论基础，指导免疫治疗联合方案的优化及个性化治疗的临床转化。

declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was not required for this study as it was entirely a computational and simulation-based research project using a publicly available, fully anonymized, and de-identified dataset (Kaggle Drug Discovery Virtual Screening Dataset). No human participants or animals were involved in the research.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no financial support or external funding for the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.

detail.abstract: Customer churn has become a major challenge for global e-commerce businesses due to increasing market competition and changing consumer behaviour. This study examines the role of machine learning and big data analytics in predicting customer churn and improving customer retention strategies. A quantitative research design with secondary data sources was adopted to analyse customer behaviour patterns and predictive modelling techniques. The findings indicate that machine learning algorithms and predictive analytics significantly improve churn prediction accuracy and support personalised customer engagement strategies. The study highlights the importance of data-driven decision-making in international e-commerce and provides practical insights for improving customer loyalty, profitability, and long-term business sustainability.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨机器学习和大数据分析在预测国际电商客户流失及提升客户留存策略中的作用，发现机器学习算法显著提高了流失预测准确性并支持个性化客户参与。
AI.research_question: 机器学习和大数据分析在预测客户流失和改善客户留存策略中发挥什么作用？
AI.motivation: 全球电商市场竞争加剧和消费者行为变化导致客户流失成为重大挑战，亟需更有效的预测和留存方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机器学习算法、预测分析、数据驱动决策、客户关系管理理论
AI.method: 定量研究设计，采用二手数据来源分析客户行为模式和预测建模技术。
AI.findings: 机器学习算法和预测分析显著提高了流失预测准确性，并支持个性化客户参与策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了机器学习和预测分析在客户流失预测中的有效性，拓展了数据驱动决策在电商客户关系管理中的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际电商企业提供了基于数据的客户留存策略建议，有助于提升客户忠诚度、盈利能力和长期业务可持续性。

title: Measuring Market Activity with AI and High-Resolution Satellite Imagery: Evidence from North Korea
affiliations: Chonnam National University, , Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST) and Max Planck Society for the Advancement of the Sciences - Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy

detail.title: Measuring Market Activity with AI and High-Resolution Satellite Imagery: Evidence from North Korea

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required because this study uses publicly available, non-human-subject data.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the KFAS Award for Social Innovation Research, Korea Foundation for Advanced Studies.

detail.abstract: Measuring marketplace activity is essential for understanding informal economies, yet reliable data remain limited because much of this activity occurs outside formal statistical systems. We develop a scalable AI-driven framework that advances existing satellite-based approaches by tracking temporal changes in marketplace footprints, enabling longitudinal measurement of informal market dynamics. Applied to North Korea, where conventional economic data are largely unavailable and direct ground-level data collection is infeasible, the framework produces a nationwide 17-year panel covering 482 marketplaces from 2008 to 2024. We show that marketplace area reflects local economic activity through cross-sectional benchmarks, macro-level responses to economic shocks, and panel regressions at multiple spatial scales. Using this validated measure, we document that marketplace expansion in North Korea was nationwide and decentralized, and that the rank-size distribution of marketplaces follows power-law patterns similar to those observed in other economies. Our findings demonstrate that AI-driven analysis of high-resolution satellite imagery provides a scalable foundation for studying the spatial dynamics of informal economic activity in fragile and data-scarce environments.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种基于AI的卫星图像分析框架，通过追踪市场足迹的时间变化来衡量非正规经济活动。以朝鲜为案例，构建了2008-2024年482个市场的17年面板数据，验证了市场面积与地方经济活动的关联，并揭示了朝鲜市场扩张是全国性、去中心化的，且市场规模的层级分布符合幂律规律。
AI.research_question: 如何利用AI驱动的卫星图像分析来测量和追踪非正规经济活动的空间动态？
AI.motivation: 非正规经济活动大多发生在正式统计系统之外，可靠数据极为有限，制约了对非正规经济的理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 卫星图像分析用于经济测量；市场规模分布与经济活动的关系；幂律分布理论在市场规模中的应用。
AI.method: 开发AI驱动的框架，利用高分辨率卫星图像追踪市场足迹的时间变化；通过截面基准比较、宏观经济冲击响应及多空间尺度的面板回归验证市场面积作为经济活动代理变量的有效性。
AI.findings: 市场面积能有效反映地方经济活动；朝鲜的市场扩张是全国性和去中心化的；市场规模分布呈现幂律模式，与其他经济体类似。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI与卫星图像分析结合，为测量数据稀缺环境下的非正规经济活动提供了可扩展的方法论框架；验证了市场规模与经济活动之间的稳健关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究朝鲜等数据稀缺国家的非正规经济提供了长达17年的大规模面板数据；为政策制定者理解非正规经济的空间动态提供了工具。

title: Entrepreneurial Spillovers from Public R&D: Evidence from the Space Race

detail.title: Entrepreneurial Spillovers from Public R&D: Evidence from the Space Race
detail.abstract: This paper studies how mission-oriented public R&D generates entrepreneurial spillovers. I use the Space Race as a large, technology-specific public R&D shock and the 1979 ERISA reform as an expansion in the supply of venture capital (VC). The Space Race created localized stocks of technical knowledge, specialized human capital, and contractor experience in space-related technologies. After the ERISA reform, VC flowed disproportionately to county-industries that had received NASA funding, and these county-industries experienced higher growth in establishments and employment. Using novel individual-level data on U.S. scientists, I further show that scientists with space-related specialties were more likely to start businesses after the VC supply expansion, especially those employed by NASA prime contractors. The findings show that public R&D spillovers operate not only through patents or incumbent-firm innovation, but also through the formation of new firms. Public R&D can create entrepreneurial potential that remains latent until VC helps in translating scientific capabilities into entrepreneurial outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究以任务为导向的公共研发如何通过创业活动产生溢出效应。利用太空竞赛作为公共研发冲击，以及1979年ERISA改革作为风险资本供给扩张，发现NASA资助地区在VC扩张后获得了更多风险资本，并经历了更高的企业和就业增长。科学家个体数据表明，航天领域科学家在VC供给扩张后更可能创业，尤其是NASA主承包商的雇员。公共研发溢出不仅通过专利或现有企业创新，还通过新企业形成来实现。
AI.research_question: 以任务为导向的公共研发如何通过创业活动产生溢出效应？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多关注公共研发通过专利或现有企业创新产生的溢出效应，但对创业渠道（即新企业形成）的研究不足。作者希望揭示公共研发如何创造创业潜力，以及风险资本如何帮助将这种潜力转化为实际的创业结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创业溢出理论、公共研发溢出理论、风险资本与创业匹配理论。核心逻辑：公共研发创造技术知识、专业人力资本和承包商经验（创业潜力），风险资本供给扩张释放这种潜力，转化为实际创业活动。
AI.method: 双重差分法（DID），利用太空竞赛（NASA资助）和ERISA改革（VC供给冲击）的双重外生冲击。使用县级-行业层面的数据，以及美国科学家个体层面的新颖数据。
AI.findings: (1) ERISA改革后，VC不成比例地流向曾获得NASA资助的县-行业；(2) 这些县-行业经历了更高的企业和就业增长；(3) 航天领域科学家在VC供给扩张后更可能创业，尤其是NASA主承包商的雇员。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 发现公共研发溢出的一条新渠道——创业（新企业形成），补充了传统专利和现有企业创新渠道；(2) 提出"创业潜力"概念，即公共研发创造的创业潜能需要VC等外部条件激活，丰富了对公共研发溢出机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为政策制定者提供启示：公共研发的创业溢出需要配套的金融基础设施（如风险资本市场）来实现其全部价值；(2) 建议公共研发政策与创业支持政策协同设计，以最大化公共资金的经济效益。

title: Digital Leapfrogging: Leveraging Techno-Intercultural Synergy Theory (TIST) to Democratize Global Higher Education Ecosystems

detail.title: Digital Leapfrogging: Leveraging Techno-Intercultural Synergy Theory (TIST) to Democratize Global Higher Education Ecosystems

declarations.funderStatement: Not funded

detail.abstract: Traditional frameworks for Collaborative Online International Learning (COIL) treat digital tools as passive background infrastructure, inadvertently penalizing Global South institutions due to baseline readiness and preparedness gaps. This policy brief challenges the status quo by operationalizing Techno-Intercultural Synergy Theory (TIST)-a paradigm shifting Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) from a utility to an agentic collaborative partner. Based on rigorous structural equation modeling (R² = .480, Cohen's d = 1.14), this brief demonstrates that AI integration serves a vital dual purpose: minimizing human intercultural friction while independently engineering standalone professional self-efficacy. Actionable macro-level policies are proposed to leverage AI as an equity multiplier, closing the systemic North-South developmental divide without high-carbon physical mobility budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出技术-跨文化协同理论（TIST），将生成式AI从工具重新定位为协作伙伴，通过结构方程建模（R²=.480, Cohen's d=1.14）证明AI既能减少跨文化摩擦，又能独立构建专业自我效能，并提出宏观政策将AI作为公平乘数，缩小南北发展差距。
AI.research_question: 如何将生成式AI从被动工具转变为主动协作者，以解决全球南方机构在跨国在线协作学习中的基础设施差距问题？
AI.motivation: 传统COIL框架将数字工具视为被动基础设施，因基线准备差距而无意中惩罚全球南方机构，亟需新范式来弥合这一系统性不平等。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术-跨文化协同理论（Techno-Intercultural Synergy Theory, TIST）——将生成式AI从效用工具重新定义为代理性协作伙伴。
AI.method: 结构方程模型（Structural Equation Modeling），R²=.480, Cohen's d=1.14。
AI.findings: AI整合发挥双重作用：最小化人际跨文化摩擦，同时独立构建专业自我效能。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了TIST理论，颠覆了AI作为被动工具的传统认知，建立了AI作为代理性协作伙伴的新理论范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出可操作的宏观政策建议，将AI作为公平乘数，在不依赖高碳物理流动的情况下缩小南北发展鸿沟。

title: US Robot Impacts in Developing Countries: Evidence from Colombian Workers
affiliations: George Washington University - School of Business, McCourt School of Public Policy  and George Mason University

detail.title: US Robot Impacts in Developing Countries: Evidence from Colombian Workers
detail.abstract: This paper examines how robotization in developed countries impacts workers' earnings and labor dynamics in developing countries. Using nearly a decade of Colombian Social Security records and US robot adoption data, we provide robust evidence that workers in industries highly exposed to US robots experience lower cumulative earnings overall and lower employment for older workers and those employed in larger firms. Workers switching firms within the same industry avoid earnings losses, while those moving across industries face the largest losses, consistent with loss of industry-specific human capital. These effects are driven by reduced Colombian exports to the US, particularly in the primary sector, and are more pronounced among older, high-earning workers and those in larger firms, plausibly more integrated into global value chains and, therefore, more directly exposed to foreign automation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用近十年的哥伦比亚社会保障记录和美国机器人采用数据，研究了发达国家机器人化如何影响发展中国家工人的收入与劳动力动态。研究发现，高度暴露于美国机器人的行业中的工人累积收入更低，老年工人和大型企业工人的就业率下降；跨行业流动的工人损失最大，这与行业特定人力资本的丧失一致。这些影响主要通过哥伦比亚对美国出口减少（尤其是初级部门）传导，对老年、高收入及大型企业工人影响更显著。
AI.research_question: 发达国家的机器人化如何影响发展中国家工人的收入和劳动力动态？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要关注自动化对发达国家本国劳动力市场的影响，但鲜有研究探讨发达国家机器人化如何通过国际贸易等渠道对发展中国家劳动力市场产生溢出效应。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行业特定人力资本理论；全球价值链与自动化溢出效应理论。
AI.method: 利用近十年的哥伦比亚社会保障个人层面面板数据，结合美国行业级机器人采用数据，采用固定效应模型和工具变量等方法进行因果识别。
AI.findings: （1）高度暴露于美国机器人的行业工人累积收入显著降低；（2）老年工人和大型企业工人就业率下降；（3）工人留在同行业换企业可避免收入损失，跨行业流动则损失最大；（4）影响机制是哥伦比亚对美国出口减少，尤其是初级部门。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从发展中国家视角实证检验发达国家自动化对发展中国家劳动力市场的溢出效应，拓展了自动化经济后果的国别维度；验证了行业特定人力资本在自动化冲击下的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家政策制定者应对发达国家自动化带来的劳动力市场冲击提供经验证据；提示需要关注老年工人、高收入工人及大型企业工人的脆弱性；为贸易政策和产业政策调整提供参考。

title: How Well Does a Rolling-Volatility Band Calibrate? Evidence Across Asset Classes and Market Regimes

detail.title: How Well Does a Rolling-Volatility Band Calibrate? Evidence Across Asset Classes and Market Regimes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has a financial interest in oisigma.com LLC, which develops and commercially distributes an invite-only TradingView indicator marketed under the name "Behavioral Transform Model." The volatility band evaluated in this paper is a variant of the construction underlying that indicator, and the abbreviation BTM is retained for continuity with it. This interest is disclosed in the interest of full transparency; the data, code, empirical results, and conclusions reported here are the author's own, and the paper makes no claim endorsing the commercial product. Beyond this, the author has no competing financial or non-financial interests to declare. The author received no external funding for this research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted by the author independently under oisigma.com LLC.

detail.abstract: Traders need a stable, asset-agnostic way to separate ordinary price fluctuation from statistically unusual movement, and the practitioner bands in common use are not calibrated to that question. We study a deliberately simple, causal volatility envelopea band built from the rolling mean and standard deviation of recent returns, anchored on the prior close-and show that it is a stably calibrated classifier of normal versus abnormal next-bar behavior across asset classes, a century of regimes, and daily-tomonthly time scales. That invariance, not the level of any single number, is the finding. On the S&P 500 (1927-2024) the inner (±1σ) band contains the next close 71.20% of the time and stays within 68.7-73.7% in every calendar decade; across a forty-asset universe the mean is 71.9% (cross-asset SD 2.3pp), and the result survives out-of-sample splits, an independently randomized universe, alternative source prices, and weekly and monthly frequencies. Because the band plugs in an estimated μ, σ, the proper null is the finite-window (prediction-t) quantile-67.46% at n = 60, not the known-parameter 68.27%. The +3.7pp excess over that null is the fingerprint of return leptokurtosis rather than an artifact: a GARCH(1,1) with Student-t(ν = 6) innovations reproduces the empirical rate within 0.08pp, and a probability-integral-transform analysis shows the departure from Gaussian is one of shape (heavy tails), not scale. The return-space construction is what carries the calibration: a standard price-space Bollinger band catches only ∼ 83% of closes within its nominal 95% envelope (versus ∼ 94% here) and is beaten on all forty assets, whereas the choice of variance estimator matters far less. The envelope is a marginal-coverage classifier-well calibrated unconditionally but not within every regime (coverage falls to 65.3% at crisis onset, VIX>30)-so it classifies next-bar dispersion rather than direction. Headline results survive Holm-Bonferroni correction at family-wise α = 0.05.
